strata.blurb_raw: Galois representations, theta lifts and Iwasawa-type cohomology bounds that are meant to produce the families on which a prime sum is small.
A finite character comparison turns geometric control of a chain of theta lifts of length about √x into an upper bound for a weighted prime sum.
A localized Landau oscillation argument converts one-sided bounds on whole power windows into a zero-free half-plane.
Euler factors, conductors and functional equations turn the half-plane theorem into the five exported statements, including Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis.

def RiemannZetaZerosOnLine : Prop :=

theorem Formalism.VW.rh_of_every (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : RiemannHypothesis :=
  Formalism.VW.rh_of_right fun s hs hs1 => by
    have := h 1 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) s hs (Or.inr hs1)
    rwa [LFunction_modOne_eq] at this

theorem Formalism.VW.rh_of_right (hz : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → s ≠ 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  unfold RiemannHypothesis
  intro s hs htriv hs1
  rcases lt_trichotomy s.re (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs
      norm_num at hs
    have ht : 1 / 2 < (1 - s).re := by
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have h1 : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hs0
      linear_combination -h
    have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 - s) ≠ -(n : ℂ) := by
      intro n h
      have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hr
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      linarith
    have key := riemannZeta_one_sub hnat h1
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, hs] at key
    have hz' := hz (1 - s) ht h1
    have h2pi : (2 : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ^ (-(1 - s)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.2 (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hpi)))
    have hG : Complex.Gamma (1 - s) ≠ 0 := Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith)
    have hcos : Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (1 - s) / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Complex.cos_eq_zero_iff]
      rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      have h3 : ((1 - s) - (2 * (k : ℂ) + 1)) * (Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by
        linear_combination 2 * hk
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h | h
      · have hsk : s = -2 * (k : ℂ) := by linear_combination -h
        have hre : s.re = -2 * (k : ℝ) := by
          rw [hsk, Complex.mul_re]
          simp
        rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk0 | hk0 | hk0
        · have : (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ -1 by omega)
          linarith
        · apply hs0
          rw [hsk, hk0]
          simp
        · apply htriv
          refine ⟨(k - 1).toNat, ?_⟩
          have hnk : ((k - 1).toNat : ℤ) = k - 1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
          have h' : (((k - 1).toNat : ℕ) : ℂ) = (k : ℂ) - 1 := by
            have := congrArg (fun m : ℤ => (m : ℂ)) hnk
            push_cast at this
            exact this
          rw [hsk, h']
          ring
      · exact hpi h
    exact (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h2pi hG) hcos) hz') key.symm
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hs (hz s hgt hs1)

theorem Formalism.VW.critLine (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℂ)
    (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1) (hz : LFunction χ s = 0) : s.re = 1 / 2 := by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by simp [e] at h0
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by simp [e] at h1
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hinv : χ⁻¹.IsPrimitive := by
      rw [isPrimitive_def, conductor_inv]; exact hχ
    have hc : completedLFunction χ s = 0 := by
      rw [LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor χ s (Or.inl hs0)] at hz
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.1 hz).resolve_right (Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero χ h0)
    have hfe := hinv.completedLFunction_one_sub s
    rw [inv_inv, hc, mul_zero] at hfe
    have h2 : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs1.symm
    refine h N χ⁻¹ (1 - s) (by rw [sub_re, one_re]; linarith) (Or.inr fun e => hs0 (by linear_combination -e)) ?_
    rw [LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor χ⁻¹ (1 - s) (Or.inl h2), hfe, zero_div]
  · exact h N χ s hgt (Or.inr hs1) hz

theorem Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) : gammaFactor χ s ≠ 0 := by
  rcases χ.even_or_odd with h | h
  · rw [h.gammaFactor_def]; exact Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs
  · rw [h.gammaFactor_def]; exact Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by rw [add_re, one_re]; linarith)

theorem strip (h : HalfPlane) : Strip := by
  unfold HalfPlane at h
  intro N _ χ s hs0 hs1 hz
  have hs : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.one_re] at hs1; exact lt_irrefl _ hs1
  have hs0' : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at hs0; exact lt_irrefl _ hs0
  rcases lt_trichotomy s.re (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    haveI : NeZero χ.conductor := ⟨χ.conductor_ne_zero⟩
    have hp := prim_zero χ hs0 hs1 hz
    have hr := prim_reflect χ.primitiveCharacter χ.primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive hs0 hs1 hp
    have ht : (1 : ℂ) - s ≠ 1 := fun e => hs0' (sub_eq_self.mp e)
    exact h χ.conductor χ.primitiveCharacter⁻¹ (1 - s)
      (by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith) (Or.inr ht) hr
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hz (h N χ s hgt (Or.inr hs))

theorem prim_reflect {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) {s : ℂ}
    (hs0 : 0 < s.re) (hs1 : s.re < 1) (h : DirichletCharacter.LFunction ψ s = 0) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction ψ⁻¹ (1 - s) = 0 := by
  have hs0' : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at hs0; exact lt_irrefl _ hs0
  have ht0 : 0 < (1 - s).re := by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith
  have ht0' : 1 - s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at ht0; exact lt_irrefl _ ht0
  have hc : DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction ψ s = 0 := by
    rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor ψ s (Or.inl hs0'),
      div_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact h.resolve_right (gamma_ne_zero ψ hs0)
  have hψ' : (ψ⁻¹).IsPrimitive := by
    rw [DirichletCharacter.isPrimitive_def, DirichletCharacter.conductor_inv]; exact hψ
  have fe := hψ'.completedLFunction_one_sub s
  rw [inv_inv, hc, mul_zero] at fe
  rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor ψ⁻¹ (1 - s) (Or.inl ht0'), fe,
    zero_div]

theorem zeta (h : HalfPlane) : Zeta := by
  intro s hz htriv hs1
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, riemannZeta_zero] at hz; norm_num at hz
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 s.re with hpos | hnpos
  · rcases lt_or_ge s.re 1 with hlt1 | hge1
    · have hL : DirichletCharacter.LFunction (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) s = 0 := by
        rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_modOne_eq]; exact hz
      exact strip h 1 1 s hpos hlt1 hL
    · exact absurd hz (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re hge1)
  · exfalso
    have hG : Gammaℝ s ≠ 0 := by
      intro hg
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.mp hg
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact hs0 (by simpa using hn)
      · exact htriv ⟨n, by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring⟩
    have hc : completedRiemannZeta s = 0 := by
      rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff] at hz
      exact hz.resolve_right hG
    have h1s : 1 - s ≠ 0 := fun e => by
      have := congrArg Complex.re e
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_re] at this
      linarith
    have hz' : riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0 := by
      rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero h1s, completedRiemannZeta_one_sub, hc, zero_div]
    exact riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re (by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith) hz'

theorem UpperTheory.riemannHypothesis_of_everyCharacter (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  intro s hs hn h1
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs; norm_num at hs
    have h1s : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := fun e => hs0 (by simpa using e)
    have hz : riemannZeta (1 - s) ≠ 0 := UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h (1 - s) (by simp; linarith) h1s
    have hc : completedRiemannZeta s = completedRiemannZeta (1 - s) := (completedRiemannZeta_one_sub s).symm
    have h1s0 : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := fun e => h1 (by linear_combination -e)
    rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact hz (by rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero h1s0, ← hc, hs, zero_div])
    · obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.1 hs
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact hs0 (by simpa using hn')
      · exact hn ⟨n, by rw [hn']; push_cast; ring⟩
  · exact UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h s hgt h1 hs

theorem prim_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) [NeZero χ.conductor] {s : ℂ}
    (hs0 : 0 < s.re) (hs1 : s.re < 1) (h : DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ.primitiveCharacter s = 0 := by
  have hs : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.one_re] at hs1; exact lt_irrefl _ hs1
  have key := DirichletCharacter.LFunction_changeLevel χ.conductor_dvd_level
    χ.primitiveCharacter (Or.inr hs)
  rw [χ.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, h] at key
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key.symm with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp h'
    exact absurd hp0 (factor_ne_zero _ hs0 p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp))

theorem factor_ne_zero {M : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p.Prime) : (1 : ℂ) - ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have h1 : ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by linear_combination -h
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hpow : ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hp.pos, Complex.neg_re]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hp1 (by linarith)
  have hn : ‖ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖ψ p‖ * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ := by
          gcongr; exact ψ.norm_le_one _
      _ < 1 := by rw [one_mul]; exact hpow
  rw [h1, norm_one] at hn
  exact lt_irrefl _ hn

theorem UpperTheory.Top.every_character_of_green_v_win (hG : GlobalTheory.GLq.Green) (hV : UpperTheory.Top.VWin)
    (h : Nonempty (_root_.GlobalTheory.Fc.HypsAlt (fun 𝒞 => Closed 𝒞 fun Fm _ => LinkN Fm) _root_.GlobalTheory.Fc.DefiniteSideCondition)) : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter :=
  UpperTheory.Top.imprimitive (_root_.UpperTheory.Top.zero_free_all_of_green_v_win hG hV h)

theorem UpperTheory.Top.imprimitive :
    ZeroFreeAll → ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (s : ℂ), 1 / 2 < s.re → (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) →
      DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0 := by
  intro h N _ χ s hs hχs
  haveI : NeZero χ.conductor := (PChar.of χ).ne
  have hL : DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ.primitiveCharacter s ≠ 0 := h (PChar.of χ) trivial s hs
  have hχ' : χ.primitiveCharacter ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1 := by
    rcases hχs with hχ | hs1
    · left
      intro h1
      apply hχ
      rw [← χ.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, h1, DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_one]
    · exact Or.inr hs1
  have hrw := DirichletCharacter.LFunction_changeLevel χ.conductor_dvd_level χ.primitiveCharacter hχ'
  rw [χ.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter] at hrw
  rw [hrw]
  refine mul_ne_zero hL (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun p hp => ?_)
  have hp' := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  intro h0
  have key : χ.primitiveCharacter p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by linear_combination -h0
  have h1 : ‖χ.primitiveCharacter (p : ZMod χ.conductor)‖ ≤ 1 := DirichletCharacter.norm_le_one _ _
  have h2 : ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hp'.pos, Complex.neg_re]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hp'.one_lt) (by linarith)
  have hn : ‖χ.primitiveCharacter p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖χ.primitiveCharacter (p : ZMod χ.conductor)‖ * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖
        ≤ 1 * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ := by gcongr
      _ < 1 := by simpa using h2
  rw [key, norm_one] at hn
  exact lt_irrefl _ hn

components.gist_raw: A ramp-weighted von Mangoldt sum, centered so that the main terms cancel exactly, and its positive combinations over a cyclic family of characters.

lean_anchors.excerpt: def Gm (y : ℝ) : ℝ := Formalism.Gz y + ∑ ψ ∈ Λ.Nt, Λ.wt ψ * (An.gChi ψ.χ y).re

theorem psi_zero_integral_constant : Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst := by
  exact Formalism.HermitianLattices.P.PsiZeroIntegral.psiZeroConst_main

private theorem psiZeroConst_main : Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst := by
  unfold Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst
  have hsub : Subsingleton (ZMod 1) := ZMod.subsingleton_iff.2 rfl
  have hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (n : ZMod 1) = 1 := fun n => by
    first
      | exact MulChar.one_apply (isUnit_of_subsingleton _)
      | simp
  have h : RemBound (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 := by
    have h0 := sw_bound 1 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h0
    simp only [hone, mul_one] at h0
    exact h0
  have hid : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ →
      (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = -(deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ + 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) - 1 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hre : (1 : ℝ) < ((σ : ℂ)).re := by simpa using hσ
    have hne : (σ : ℂ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [sub_ne_zero]
      exact_mod_cast hσ.ne'
    have hne' : -(σ : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      linear_combination -h0
    have hsum : LSeriesSummable (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ := by
      first
        | exact ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hre
        | exact LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hre
    have hL := LSeries_eq_mul_integral (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) zero_le_one hre hsum (rem_bigO h)
    have key : LSeries (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ = -deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ :=
      LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div hre
    have hpint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ))) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_cpow_of_lt (by simpa using hσ) one_pos
    have hsplit : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (∑ k ∈ Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, ((Λ k : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = (∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
          + ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) := by
      rw [← integral_add (core_integrable' h hσ.le) hpint]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun t ht => ?_)
      have ht0 : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℝ) < t from lt_trans one_pos ht).ne'
      simp only [rem]
      rw [show -(σ : ℂ) = 1 + (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)) by ring, Complex.cpow_add _ _ ht0, Complex.cpow_one]
      ring
    have hpow : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) = 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1) := by
      rw [integral_Ioi_cpow_of_lt (by simpa using hσ) one_pos, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.one_cpow,
        div_eq_div_iff hne' hne]
      ring
    have hq : (σ : ℂ) * (1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) = 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1) + 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_add_one hne]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hmain : (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
        rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = LSeries (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ - (σ : ℂ) * (1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) := by
      rw [hL, hsplit, hpow]
      ring
    rw [hmain, key, hq]
    ring
  have hG : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => -(deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ + 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) - 1)
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (-(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) - 1)) :=
    ((zeta_logderiv_limit.comp ofReal_tendsto_punctured).neg).sub_const 1
  have hF : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
      rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (-(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) - 1)) := by
    refine hG.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
    exact (hid σ hσ).symm
  have hlim := tendsto_nhds_unique (core_tendsto h) hF
  have hF1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
      rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 u * (u : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1))
        = (((Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [show -(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1) = -((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) by norm_num, Complex.cpow_neg, Complex.cpow_natCast]
    simp only [rem, Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => (Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2)
      (Set.Ioi 1) := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.Integrable.re (core_integrable h)).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    simp only [hF1 u hu, RCLike.re_to_complex, Complex.ofReal_re]

        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hExp hBr))

    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le w1 (by nlinarith)

theorem ch_top {H : Type} [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {U0 : Type} [Fintype U0] {W : U0 → Type} [∀ u0, Fintype (W u0)] [∀ u0, Nonempty (W u0)]
    {Top : Type} [Fintype Top] {m f : ℕ} (Dd : Data U0 W Top m f) (tr : U0 → H) (C : Consts) (Xpp eK K : ℝ)
    (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ)
    (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ) (eT : Top ≃ TT) (eP : Fin f ≃ PhiSet (H := H))
    (h1 : IdentU Dd tr D N ell TT a w eT eP) (h2 : SizeData₂ Dd C Xpp) (h3 : ErrWindows Dd C Xpp eK K) (h4 : BNBoundsU Dd T2)
    (h5 : LargeX Dd.x Dd.ε K C.cHH eK) (u : U0) :
    gapA D N ell TT a w (tr u) ≤
      Dd.x ^ (CErr C * Dd.ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a := by
  have hmain := ch_top_main_eq Dd tr D N ell TT a w eT eP h1 u
  have hask := h1.2.2.2.2 u
  have hgap : gapA D N ell TT a w (tr u) = Dd.ASK u - Dd.Main u := by
    rw [hask, hmain]
    unfold gapA
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10, s11⟩ := h2
  have hle := each_unit_bound_statement Dd C Xpp s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 s7 s8 s9 s10 s11 u
  have herr := errX5at_le Dd C Xpp eK K h3 h5 u
  have hnT : Dd.nT = (TT.card : ℝ) := by
    unfold Data.nT
    have := Fintype.card_congr eT
    rw [Fintype.card_coe] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have htext : ErrText Dd ≤ errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a := by
    unfold ErrText errorBracketSizeWindows
    rw [hnT]
    have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    gcongr
    · exact h4.1
    · exact h4.2
  have hpow : 0 ≤ Dd.x ^ (CErr C * Dd.ε) := Real.rpow_nonneg s1.1.le _
  rw [hgap]
  calc Dd.ASK u - Dd.Main u ≤ _ := by linarith
    _ ≤ _ := herr
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htext hpow

theorem ch_core (C ε CE Ko c M : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hε : 0 < ε) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : ∃ x1 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x1,

      (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ) (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ)
      (b b' k aE η X' θ : ℝ) (A0 : AddSubgroup H) (Kp : Finset (AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ)),
      HostFactsS D S → 0 < b → 0 ≤ aE → 0 < k → (m : ℝ) ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + ε / 2) → x * m ≤ k →
      SizesA A0 TT T2 a w N x b b' η X' θ → ThinScales D ell X' θ → CostWindows x (fPl H) b η θ →
      RestSize ε x (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE → (∀ s ∈ T2, s ∈ A0) → CharsA ell A0 Kp TT c M Ko CE ε x →
      (∀ u ∈ A0, gapA D N ell TT a w u ≤ x ^ (C * ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows x ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE) →
      GmA D ell Kp c x ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (C + 3) * ε) + SigA D ell A0 Kp x := by

theorem vvRecord (D : D7) (B : ℝ) (h : VVle D.host.E D.R.t B) :
    ShaFinOdd D ∧ Summable (vvTerm D) ∧ ∑' l, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by
  letI := D.nd.instOm
  letI := D.nd.algOm
  haveI := D.nd.acOm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h D.nd.Om D.nd.ldat
  have key : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], ((∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, D.what₂.shaLen p e : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro p _
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 he
    rw [D.nd.sha_eq p e a b _ (ENat.coe_toNat (h1 p e a b)).symm]
    norm_cast
  have bd : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 ≤ vvTerm D l ∧ ∀ hl : l.Prime, vvTerm D l ≤ Real.log l *
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((@Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen _ D.nd.Om _ _ _ _ _ l ⟨hl⟩ (@Formalism.BasicNotions.NData.ldat _ _ _ D.nd l ⟨hl⟩) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : l.Prime
    · haveI : Fact l.Prime := ⟨hl⟩
      have hk := key l
      have hn : 0 ≤ Real.log l * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat l) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      unfold vvTerm
      split_ifs
      all_goals first
        | exact ⟨le_rfl, fun _ => hn⟩
        | (rw [hk, mul_comm]; exact ⟨hn, fun _ => le_rfl⟩)
    · have : vvTerm D l = 0 := by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl]
      exact ⟨this.ge, fun h => absurd h hl⟩
  have part : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, ∑ l ∈ s, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by
    intro s
    classical
    refine le_trans ?_ (h2 (s.subtype Nat.Prime))
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := Nat.Prime) (fun l _ hne => by
      by_contra hl
      exact hne (by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl])), ← Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => (bd l).2 l.2
  refine ⟨?_, summable_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part⟩
  intro p _ e
  intros
  exact h1 p e ‹_› ‹_›

theorem key_minor_dvd {A : Type} [CommRing A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (w : A) (hw : w ^ 2 = (p : A)) (k e : ℕ)
    (u u' : Fin (k + 1) → A) (M N' : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → A)
    (hMN : ∀ b a, ∃ T, M b a ^ (p ^ e) = N' b a + p * T)
    (hu : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u b) (hu' : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u' b) (c : Fin (k + 1)) :
    w ∣ (∑ b, u' b * N' b c) * (∑ b, u b * M b 0) ^ (p ^ e) - (∑ b, u' b * N' b 0) * (∑ b, u b * M b c) ^ (p ^ e) := by

  apply (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w _).mp
  set φ := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {w}) with hφ
  have hw0 : φ w = 0 := (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w w).mpr dvd_rfl
  have hp0 : φ (p : A) = 0 := by rw [← hw, map_pow, hw0, zero_pow two_ne_zero]
  have hrow : ∀ (x : Fin (k + 1) → A) (Q : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → A), (∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ x b) →
      ∀ a, φ (∑ b, x b * Q b a) = φ (x 0) * φ (Q 0 a) := by
    intro x Q hx a
    have hz : ∀ i : Fin k, φ (x i.succ) = 0 := fun i =>
      (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w _).mpr (hx _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _))
    rw [map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, map_mul]
    simp [hz]
  have hpow : ∀ a, φ (M 0 a) ^ (p ^ e) = φ (N' 0 a) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hMN 0 a
    rw [← map_pow, hT, map_add, map_mul, hp0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hrow u' N' hu' c, hrow u M hu 0, hrow u' N' hu' 0,
    hrow u M hu c, mul_pow, mul_pow, hpow 0, hpow c]
  ring

nodes.title: Reflect a zeta zero
nodes.contract: Right-half-plane zeta nonvanishing away from one implies Mathlib RH.
nodes.idea: The functional equation reflects a left-hand zero. Gamma and cosine factors are nonzero once zero and the negative even integers are excluded.
nodes.lean_head: theorem Formalism.VW.rh_of_right (hz : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → s ≠ 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0) : RiemannHypothesis
nodes.excerpt:
theorem Formalism.VW.rh_of_right (hz : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → s ≠ 1 → riemannZeta s ≠ 0) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  unfold RiemannHypothesis
  intro s hs htriv hs1
  rcases lt_trichotomy s.re (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs
      norm_num at hs
    have ht : 1 / 2 < (1 - s).re := by
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have h1 : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hs0
      linear_combination -h
    have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 - s) ≠ -(n : ℂ) := by
      intro n h
      have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hr
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      linarith
    have key := riemannZeta_one_sub hnat h1
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, hs] at key
    have hz' := hz (1 - s) ht h1
    have h2pi : (2 : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ^ (-(1 - s)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.2 (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hpi)))
    have hG : Complex.Gamma (1 - s) ≠ 0 := Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith)
    have hcos : Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (1 - s) / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Complex.cos_eq_zero_iff]
      rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      have h3 : ((1 - s) - (2 * (k : ℂ) + 1)) * (Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by
        linear_combination 2 * hk
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h | h
      · have hsk : s = -2 * (k : ℂ) := by linear_combination -h
        have hre : s.re = -2 * (k : ℝ) := by
          rw [hsk, Complex.mul_re]
          simp
        rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk0 | hk0 | hk0
        · have : (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ -1 by omega)
          linarith
        · apply hs0
          rw [hsk, hk0]
          simp
        · apply htriv
          refine ⟨(k - 1).toNat, ?_⟩
          have hnk : ((k - 1).toNat : ℤ) = k - 1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
          have h' : (((k - 1).toNat : ℕ) : ℂ) = (k : ℂ) - 1 := by
            have := congrArg (fun m : ℤ => (m : ℂ)) hnk
            push_cast at this
            exact this
          rw [hsk, h']
          ring
      · exact hpi h
    exact (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h2pi hG) hcos) hz') key.symm
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hs (hz s hgt hs1)

nodes.title: Reflect a primitive character
nodes.contract: EveryCharacter implies the primitive open-strip conclusion.
nodes.idea: The completed functional equation reflects the zero to the inverse character at 1−s.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem Formalism.VW.critLine (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℂ)
    (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1) (hz : LFunction χ s = 0) : s.re = 1 / 2
nodes.excerpt:
theorem Formalism.VW.critLine (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) (s : ℂ)
    (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1) (hz : LFunction χ s = 0) : s.re = 1 / 2 := by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by simp [e] at h0
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by simp [e] at h1
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hinv : χ⁻¹.IsPrimitive := by
      rw [isPrimitive_def, conductor_inv]; exact hχ
    have hc : completedLFunction χ s = 0 := by
      rw [LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor χ s (Or.inl hs0)] at hz
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.1 hz).resolve_right (Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero χ h0)
    have hfe := hinv.completedLFunction_one_sub s
    rw [inv_inv, hc, mul_zero] at hfe
    have h2 : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs1.symm
    refine h N χ⁻¹ (1 - s) (by rw [sub_re, one_re]; linarith) (Or.inr fun e => hs0 (by linear_combination -e)) ?_
    rw [LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor χ⁻¹ (1 - s) (Or.inl h2), hfe, zero_div]
  · exact h N χ s hgt (Or.inr hs1) hz

nodes.title: Gamma factors in the strip
nodes.contract: For every character χ and Re(s)>0 its gamma factor at s is nonzero.
nodes.idea: Use the even and odd formulas and Gammaℝ nonvanishing in the positive half-plane.
nodes.lean_head: theorem Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) : gammaFactor χ s ≠ 0
nodes.excerpt:
theorem Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) : gammaFactor χ s ≠ 0 := by
  rcases χ.even_or_odd with h | h
  · rw [h.gammaFactor_def]; exact Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs
  · rw [h.gammaFactor_def]; exact Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by rw [add_re, one_re]; linarith)

nodes.title: Reflect an arbitrary character
nodes.contract: Claim.HalfPlane implies Claim.Strip.
nodes.idea: Reduce a left-hand zero to its primitive inducing character, reflect it, then use h. A right-hand zero directly contradicts h.
nodes.lean_head: theorem strip (h : HalfPlane) : Strip
nodes.excerpt:
theorem strip (h : HalfPlane) : Strip := by
  unfold HalfPlane at h
  intro N _ χ s hs0 hs1 hz
  have hs : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.one_re] at hs1; exact lt_irrefl _ hs1
  have hs0' : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at hs0; exact lt_irrefl _ hs0
  rcases lt_trichotomy s.re (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    haveI : NeZero χ.conductor := ⟨χ.conductor_ne_zero⟩
    have hp := prim_zero χ hs0 hs1 hz
    have hr := prim_reflect χ.primitiveCharacter χ.primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive hs0 hs1 hp
    have ht : (1 : ℂ) - s ≠ 1 := fun e => hs0' (sub_eq_self.mp e)
    exact h χ.conductor χ.primitiveCharacter⁻¹ (1 - s)
      (by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith) (Or.inr ht) hr
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hz (h N χ s hgt (Or.inr hs))

nodes.title: Remove imprimitive Euler factors
nodes.contract: An imprimitive character zero in 0<Re(s)<1 gives a zero of its primitive inducing character.
nodes.idea: Change level. Every removed prime factor has the form 1−χ(p)p^(−s), with the second term of norm less than one.
nodes.excerpt:
theorem prim_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) [NeZero χ.conductor] {s : ℂ}
    (hs0 : 0 < s.re) (hs1 : s.re < 1) (h : DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ.primitiveCharacter s = 0 := by
  have hs : s ≠ 1 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.one_re] at hs1; exact lt_irrefl _ hs1
  have key := DirichletCharacter.LFunction_changeLevel χ.conductor_dvd_level
    χ.primitiveCharacter (Or.inr hs)
  rw [χ.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, h] at key
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key.symm with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp h'
    exact absurd hp0 (factor_ne_zero _ hs0 p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp))

nodes.title: Nonzero removed Euler factor
nodes.contract: For prime p and Re(s)>0, 1−ψ(p)p^(−s)≠0.
nodes.idea: Use the bound on the norm of a character and the strict decay of p^(−Re(s)).
nodes.lean_head:
theorem factor_ne_zero {M : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p.Prime) : (1 : ℂ) - ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) ≠ 0
nodes.excerpt:
theorem factor_ne_zero {M : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p.Prime) : (1 : ℂ) - ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have h1 : ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by linear_combination -h
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hpow : ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hp.pos, Complex.neg_re]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hp1 (by linarith)
  have hn : ‖ψ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖ψ p‖ * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ := by
          gcongr; exact ψ.norm_le_one _
      _ < 1 := by rw [one_mul]; exact hpow
  rw [h1, norm_one] at hn
  exact lt_irrefl _ hn

nodes.title: Transfer a primitive zero to 1−s
nodes.contract: At an open-strip zero of a primitive ψ, its inverse has a zero at 1−s.
nodes.idea: Use the completed functional equation and nonvanishing of gamma in the strip.
nodes.excerpt:
theorem prim_reflect {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) {s : ℂ}
    (hs0 : 0 < s.re) (hs1 : s.re < 1) (h : DirichletCharacter.LFunction ψ s = 0) :
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction ψ⁻¹ (1 - s) = 0 := by
  have hs0' : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at hs0; exact lt_irrefl _ hs0
  have ht0 : 0 < (1 - s).re := by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith
  have ht0' : 1 - s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, Complex.zero_re] at ht0; exact lt_irrefl _ ht0
  have hc : DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction ψ s = 0 := by
    rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor ψ s (Or.inl hs0'),
      div_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact h.resolve_right (gamma_ne_zero ψ hs0)
  have hψ' : (ψ⁻¹).IsPrimitive := by
    rw [DirichletCharacter.isPrimitive_def, DirichletCharacter.conductor_inv]; exact hψ
  have fe := hψ'.completedLFunction_one_sub s
  rw [inv_inv, hc, mul_zero] at fe
  rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_completed_div_gammaFactor ψ⁻¹ (1 - s) (Or.inl ht0'), fe,
    zero_div]

nodes.title: Zeta component of the conjunction
nodes.contract: Claim.HalfPlane implies Claim.Zeta.
nodes.idea: Use strip at modulus one in the interior, established nonvanishing for Re(s)≥1, and completed zeta symmetry on the left.
nodes.lean_head: theorem zeta (h : HalfPlane) : Zeta
nodes.excerpt:
theorem zeta (h : HalfPlane) : Zeta := by
  intro s hz htriv hs1
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun e => by rw [e, riemannZeta_zero] at hz; norm_num at hz
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 s.re with hpos | hnpos
  · rcases lt_or_ge s.re 1 with hlt1 | hge1
    · have hL : DirichletCharacter.LFunction (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) s = 0 := by
        rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_modOne_eq]; exact hz
      exact strip h 1 1 s hpos hlt1 hL
    · exact absurd hz (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re hge1)
  · exfalso
    have hG : Gammaℝ s ≠ 0 := by
      intro hg
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.mp hg
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact hs0 (by simpa using hn)
      · exact htriv ⟨n, by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring⟩
    have hc : completedRiemannZeta s = 0 := by
      rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff] at hz
      exact hz.resolve_right hG
    have h1s : 1 - s ≠ 0 := fun e => by
      have := congrArg Complex.re e
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_re] at this
      linarith
    have hz' : riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0 := by
      rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero h1s, completedRiemannZeta_one_sub, hc, zero_div]
    exact riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re (by rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith) hz'

    · exact Or.inr hs1

  have hp' := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  intro h0
  have key : χ.primitiveCharacter p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by linear_combination -h0
  have h1 : ‖χ.primitiveCharacter (p : ZMod χ.conductor)‖ ≤ 1 := DirichletCharacter.norm_le_one _ _
  have h2 : ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hp'.pos, Complex.neg_re]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hp'.one_lt) (by linarith)
  have hn : ‖χ.primitiveCharacter p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖χ.primitiveCharacter (p : ZMod χ.conductor)‖ * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖
        ≤ 1 * ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ := by gcongr
      _ < 1 := by simpa using h2
  rw [key, norm_one] at hn
  exact lt_irrefl _ hn

nodes.title: Combine divisibility, slopes and windows
nodes.contract: The listed existence, local, rank, divisibility, global and slope controls produce FamilyClassConnected.
nodes.idea: Construct one family after taking a common epsilon threshold. Its loss exponents are the given eD and eL.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem topDesWin (𝒞 𝒞' ℰ : FamClass) (Cabs C0 eD eL : ℝ) (hEx : DesignExists (WithTw (WithSm 𝒞')) C0)
    (h1 : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), 𝒞' Fm → 𝒞 Fm) (h2 : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), 𝒞' Fm → ℰ Fm)
    (hV : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), ℰ Fm → HypV Fm.toFamCore)
    (hN : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkN Fm)
    (hEta : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkEta Fm)
    (hIRR : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkIRR Fm)
    (hZ : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => SmallLevelRankEq Fm)
    (hDIV : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => TuSize Fm → DGamSize Fm → LinkDIVt Fm Cabs CH)
    (hRk : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => ChosenE Fm C0 CH → NuFullF Fm ∧ J.MuRank Fm)
    (hG : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkG Fm)
    (hS : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => TuSize Fm → LinkS Fm C0)
    (hGL : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => TuSize Fm → DGamSize Fm → LinkGLOBAL Fm Cabs CH C0 eD eL) : FamilyClassConnected ℰ
nodes.excerpt:
theorem topDesWin (𝒞 𝒞' ℰ : FamClass) (Cabs C0 eD eL : ℝ) (hEx : DesignExists (WithTw (WithSm 𝒞')) C0)
    (h1 : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), 𝒞' Fm → 𝒞 Fm) (h2 : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), 𝒞' Fm → ℰ Fm)
    (hV : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps), ℰ Fm → HypV Fm.toFamCore)
    (hN : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkN Fm)
    (hEta : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkEta Fm)
    (hIRR : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkIRR Fm)
    (hZ : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => SmallLevelRankEq Fm)
    (hDIV : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => TuSize Fm → DGamSize Fm → LinkDIVt Fm Cabs CH)
    (hRk : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => ChosenE Fm C0 CH → NuFullF Fm ∧ J.MuRank Fm)
    (hG : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => LinkG Fm)
    (hS : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm _ => TuSize Fm → LinkS Fm C0)
    (hGL : Closed (Des 𝒞 C0) fun Fm CH => TuSize Fm → DGamSize Fm → LinkGLOBAL Fm Cabs CH C0 eD eL) : FamilyClassConnected ℰ := by
  obtain ⟨ε1, hε1, hA⟩ := hN.and (hDIV.and (hEta.and (hIRR.and (hZ.and (hRk.and (hG.and (hS.and hGL)))))))
  obtain ⟨ε3, hε3, hEx⟩ := hEx
  refine ⟨eD, eL, min ε1 ε3, lt_min hε1 hε3, fun ε h0 hlt => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hA ε h0 (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_left _ _)))
  obtain ⟨Fm, CH, hc, -, hL, hCh, hT, hDG⟩ := hEx ε h0 (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_right _ _))) K
  obtain ⟨aN, aD, aE, aI, aZ, aR, aG, aS, aGL⟩ := hK Fm CH ⟨⟨⟨h1 Fm hc.1.1, hc.1.2⟩, hc.2⟩, ⟨CH, hCh⟩, hT, hDG⟩ hL
  have hD := aD hT hDG aE (divinN_of_hypV Fm h0 (hV Fm (h2 Fm hc.1.1)) aN aZ)
  exact ⟨Fm, h2 Fm hc.1.1, aGL hT hDG hCh ⟨aG, aS hT, aI, hD,
    J.linkMu_of_linkDIV Fm hD (aR hCh).1 (aR hCh).2 (muTu_of_tuSize Fm h0 hT) (J.muDGam_of_fact Fm hDG)⟩⟩

nodes.title: Control the local divisibility loss
nodes.contract: For ε>0, HypV, LinkN and SmallLevelRankEq imply DIVinN on the family.
nodes.idea: Bound the weighted cohomology sum, replace the rank and absorb log²x into x^ε.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem divinN_of_hypV {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps) (heps : 0 < eps) (hV : HypV Fm.toFamCore) (hN : LinkN Fm) (hR : SmallLevelRankEq Fm) :
    DIVinN Fm
nodes.excerpt:
theorem divinN_of_hypV {eps : ℝ} (Fm : FamP eps) (heps : 0 < eps) (hV : HypV Fm.toFamCore) (hN : LinkN Fm) (hR : SmallLevelRankEq Fm) :
    DIVinN Fm := by
  obtain ⟨x1, h1⟩ := hV
  obtain ⟨C, x3, h3⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨x4, h4⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨x6, h6⟩ := log_sq_le_rpow heps
  refine ⟨|C| + 1, max (max x1 (max x3 x4)) (max x6 (Fm.x1 + 1)), fun x hx i j hj => ?_⟩
  simp only [ge_iff_le, max_le_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨⟨g1, g3, g4⟩, g6, g7⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hf, hs, hle⟩ := vvRecord _ _ (h1 x g1 i)
  have hb : 1 ≤ (Fm.L x i).sc.b := Real.one_le_exp (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [(Fm.L x i).sc.one_lt_alt]) _)
  refine divinN_at _ j C hj (h3 x g3 i hf j hj) hs (hle.trans (Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.2 (Or.inr hb))) (h4 x g4 i j hj) ?_
  rw [Fm.L_x x i (by linarith), Fm.L_eps x i]
  exact h6 x g6

nodes.title: Sum the local losses
nodes.contract: VVle gives finite cohomology lengths, summability and the bound on the infinite sum of vvTerm.
nodes.idea: Apply the bounded-partial-sums criterion to nonnegative prime contributions.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem vvRecord (D : D7) (B : ℝ) (h : VVle D.host.E D.R.t B) :
    ShaFinOdd D ∧ Summable (vvTerm D) ∧ ∑' l, vvTerm D l ≤ B
nodes.excerpt:
theorem vvRecord (D : D7) (B : ℝ) (h : VVle D.host.E D.R.t B) :
    ShaFinOdd D ∧ Summable (vvTerm D) ∧ ∑' l, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by
  letI := D.nd.instOm
  letI := D.nd.algOm
  haveI := D.nd.acOm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h D.nd.Om D.nd.ldat
  have key : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], ((∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, D.what₂.shaLen p e : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro p _
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 he
    rw [D.nd.sha_eq p e a b _ (ENat.coe_toNat (h1 p e a b)).symm]
    norm_cast
  have bd : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 ≤ vvTerm D l ∧ ∀ hl : l.Prime, vvTerm D l ≤ Real.log l *
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((@Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen _ D.nd.Om _ _ _ _ _ l ⟨hl⟩ (@Formalism.BasicNotions.NData.ldat _ _ _ D.nd l ⟨hl⟩) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : l.Prime
    · haveI : Fact l.Prime := ⟨hl⟩
      have hk := key l
      have hn : 0 ≤ Real.log l * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 D.R.t, ((Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen (D.nd.ldat l) (e : ℤ)).toNat : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      unfold vvTerm
      split_ifs
      all_goals first
        | exact ⟨le_rfl, fun _ => hn⟩
        | (rw [hk, mul_comm]; exact ⟨hn, fun _ => le_rfl⟩)
    · have : vvTerm D l = 0 := by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl]
      exact ⟨this.ge, fun h => absurd h hl⟩
  have part : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, ∑ l ∈ s, vvTerm D l ≤ B := by
    intro s
    classical
    refine le_trans ?_ (h2 (s.subtype Nat.Prime))
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := Nat.Prime) (fun l _ hne => by
      by_contra hl
      exact hne (by unfold vvTerm; simp [hl])), ← Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => (bd l).2 l.2
  refine ⟨?_, summable_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le (fun l => (bd l).1) part⟩
  intro p _ e
  intros
  exact h1 p e ‹_› ‹_›

nodes.title: Produce primitive zero-free levels
nodes.contract: For λ>1, TopG and hosts for every primitive character imply ZeroFreeAll.
nodes.idea: Combine the host supply, bound on tied families and the analytic criterion at each cyclic level.
nodes.lean_head: theorem zeroFreeAll_of_topG {la : ℝ} (hla : 1 < la) (h : TopG) (hS : ∀ ψ : PChar, HostExW la (GChi ψ).req) : ZeroFreeAll

theorem zeroFreeAll_of_topG {la : ℝ} (hla : 1 < la) (h : TopG) (hS : ∀ ψ : PChar, HostExW la (GChi ψ).req) : ZeroFreeAll := by
  have key : ZeroFreeOn fun _ => True :=
    zeroFreeOn_of_tiedWin_cyc (Fam := FamP) (core := fun Fm => Fm.toFamCore) (Tied := fun Fm => ChainTied Fm) hla
      (fun ψ _ => UpperTheory.Comparison₂.level_gm_le_on_family_scales _) (fun ψ _ => UpperTheory.Comparison₂.formB _) fun ψ _ => by
        obtain ⟨eD, eL, ε₁, h1, h2⟩ := h la (GChi ψ) hla (hS ψ) (hypV_of_cls ψ la)
        refine ⟨eD, eL, ε₁, h1, fun eps a b => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨Fm, c, d⟩ := h2 eps a b
        exact ⟨Fm, eFamC_of_cls ψ la Fm c, c.1, d⟩
  exact key

nodes.title: Choose epsilon after a candidate zero
nodes.contract: At any level, the chosen uniform arithmetic window and the analytic criterion imply zero-freeness right of one half.
nodes.idea: Take θ strictly between one half and the candidate real part, then choose ε with the loss exponent below θ.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem level_of_tiedWin {Λ : Level} {la : ℝ} (h112 : ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows @core @Tied Λ) (hB : Λ.FormBAt la)
    (h : ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale @core @Tied la Λ) : Λ.ZeroFreeLevel
nodes.excerpt:
theorem level_of_tiedWin {Λ : Level} {la : ℝ} (h112 : ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows @core @Tied Λ) (hB : Λ.FormBAt la)
    (h : ChebyshevInequalityAtWindowScale @core @Tied la Λ) : Λ.ZeroFreeLevel := by
  obtain ⟨eD, eL, ε₁, h1, h⟩ := h
  intro ψ hψ s hs
  have hm1 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ s.re - 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hm0 : 0 < min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) := lt_min (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεlt, hCe⟩ := exists_small_eps (eD + eL + 7) (half_pos hm0) h1
  obtain ⟨Fm, hE, hW, hT⟩ := h ε hε0 hεlt
  obtain ⟨x1, hx⟩ := h112 eD eL ε hε0 Fm hE hT
  refine hB (1 / 2 + min (s.re - 1 / 2) (1 / 2) / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (((windows_iff _ la).1 hW).mono (x0 := max x1 1) fun y hy hw => ?_) ψ hψ s (by linarith)
  exact (hx y (le_of_max_le_left hy) hw).trans
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (le_of_max_le_right hy) (by linarith))

nodes.title: Estimate the weighted level on a window

theorem windowInequality_of_artinInputs
    (h : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : Fam eps) (eD eL K cHH eK CL x : ℝ), Tied Fm eD eL K cHH eK CL x → FamCoreConstantBounds (core Fm) eD eL K cHH eK x)

nodes.excerpt:
theorem windowInequality_of_artinInputs
    (h : ∀ {eps : ℝ} (Fm : Fam eps) (eD eL K cHH eK CL x : ℝ), Tied Fm eD eL K cHH eK CL x → FamCoreConstantBounds (core Fm) eD eL K cHH eK x)
    (Λ : Level) : ChebyshevInequalityOnWindows @core @Tied Λ := by
  rintro eD eL eps he Fm ⟨C, xE, hE⟩ ⟨K, cHH, eK, CL, x0, hT⟩
  obtain ⟨x1, hx1⟩ := core_gm Λ eD eL K cHH eK C eps he
  refine ⟨max x1 (max x0 xE), fun x hx hw => ?_⟩
  have b := le_of_max_le_right hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h Fm _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hT x (le_of_max_le_left b) hw)
  exact hx1 x (le_of_max_le_left hx) _ ((core Fm).D x i).host.toHostAx _ (hE x (le_of_max_le_right b) i) hi

nodes.title: From the height discrepancy to the prime sum
nodes.contract: For large x, EAtH and CoreAtH imply G_P(x)≤x^(1/2+(eD+eL+7)ε).
nodes.idea: Bound the per-index discrepancy, average via the character estimate and absorb the level-dependent factor into x^ε.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem UpperTheory.Comparison₂.core_gm :
    ∀ (Λ : Level) (eD eL K cHH eK C eps : ℝ), 0 < eps → ∃ x1 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x1, ∀ (φ : Frame) (H : HostAx φ) (TT : Finset φ.A),
      EAtH Λ H.toHostRaw TT x eps C → CoreAtH H.toHostRaw TT eD eL K cHH eK eps x →
        Λ.Gm x ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (eD + eL + 7) * eps)
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.Comparison₂.core_gm :
    ∀ (Λ : Level) (eD eL K cHH eK C eps : ℝ), 0 < eps → ∃ x1 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x1, ∀ (φ : Frame) (H : HostAx φ) (TT : Finset φ.A),
      EAtH Λ H.toHostRaw TT x eps C → CoreAtH H.toHostRaw TT eD eL K cHH eK eps x →
        Λ.Gm x ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (eD + eL + 7) * eps) := by
  intro Λ eD eL K cHH eK C eps heps
  have ho : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Λ.o := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hc : |(3 * (Λ.o : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := Deduction.ch_core (max (eD + eL) 0 + 3) eps C (koOf Λ) (3 * (Λ.o : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ (4 * (Λ.o : ℝ))
    (by positivity) heps hc
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := large_x_eventually eps K cHH eK heps
  obtain ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1
    ((tendsto_rpow_atTop heps).eventually_ge_atTop (1 + 4 * (Λ.o : ℝ)))
  refine ⟨max x₁ (max x₂ x₃), fun x hx φ H TT hE hCore => ?_⟩
  have g1 : x₁ ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have g2 : x₂ ≤ x := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  have g3 : x₃ ≤ x := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  obtain ⟨U0, i0, tr, W, i4, i5, Top, i6, m, f, Dd, Cc, Xpp, ell, N, T2, a, w, eT, eP, η, X', θ,
    hell, hxx, hε, heD, heL, hcHH, hcov, hId, hLed, hWin, hBN, hSz, hThin, hCost, hRest, hT2⟩ := hCore
  subst hxx hε
  have hLX := hx₂ _ g2
  have hWin' := hWin
  obtain ⟨⟨w1, w2, w3, w4, w5, w6, w7, w8, w9, w10, w11, w12, w13, w14, w15, w16, w17, w18, w19, w20, w21, w22,
    w23, w24, w25, w26, w27, wC⟩, wEta⟩ := hWin'
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17⟩ := wC
  have hLX' : LargeX Dd.x Dd.ε K Cc.cHH eK := by
    refine ⟨hLX.1, le_trans ?_ hLX.2⟩
    unfold KBig
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)) (by linarith)
  have hb : 0 < Dd.b := by linarith
  have hx0 : 0 < Dd.x := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < Dd.k := by linarith
  have ha : 0 ≤ Dd.a := le_trans (by positivity) w5
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ eD + eL := by linarith
  rw [max_eq_left hE0] at hx₁
  have hBr : 0 ≤ errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card φ.A) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a := by
    unfold errorBracketSizeWindows
    positivity
  have hExp : Dd.x ^ (CErr Cc * Dd.ε) ≤ Dd.x ^ ((eD + eL + 3) * Dd.ε) := by
    refine Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le w1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ w2.le)
    unfold CErr
    linarith
  have hmain := hx₁ _ g1 φ.A m (arith H.toHostRaw) _ ell N TT T2 a w Dd.b Dd.b' Dd.k Dd.a η X' θ φ.A0
    (keptA Λ H.toHostRaw) (hostFactsS φ H) hb ha hk w7 w8 hSz hThin hCost hRest hT2
    (charsA Λ φ H TT _ _ C ell hx0 hE hell) (fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hcov u hu
      exact le_trans (Deduction.ch_top Dd tr Cc Xpp eK K _ ell N TT T2 a w eT eP hId hLed hWin hBN hLX' v)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hExp hBr))
  rw [gmA_eq Λ φ H TT _ _ C ell hE hell] at hmain
  have hs := sigA_le Λ φ H TT _ _ C ell hx0 hE hell
  have h1 : Dd.x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + Dd.ε) ≤ Dd.x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (eD + eL + 3 + 3) * Dd.ε) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le w1 (by nlinarith)

    congr 1

    (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (eD + eL + 3 + 3) * Dd.ε))
  have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (show 0 ≤ 4 * (Λ.o : ℝ) by positivity)

nodes.title: Bound the discrepancy per index
nodes.contract: The named identifications and size, error, and norm windows give an upper bound for gapA.
nodes.idea: Write gapA as ASK minus Main, then combine the per-index estimate and the error bracket.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem ch_top {H : Type} [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {U0 : Type} [Fintype U0] {W : U0 → Type} [∀ u0, Fintype (W u0)] [∀ u0, Nonempty (W u0)]
    {Top : Type} [Fintype Top] {m f : ℕ} (Dd : Data U0 W Top m f) (tr : U0 → H) (C : Consts) (Xpp eK K : ℝ)
    (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ)
    (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ) (eT : Top ≃ TT) (eP : Fin f ≃ PhiSet (H := H))
    (h1 : IdentU Dd tr D N ell TT a w eT eP) (h2 : SizeData₂ Dd C Xpp) (h3 : ErrWindows Dd C Xpp eK K) (h4 : BNBoundsU Dd T2)
    (h5 : LargeX Dd.x Dd.ε K C.cHH eK) (u : U0) :
    gapA D N ell TT a w (tr u) ≤
      Dd.x ^ (CErr C * Dd.ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a
nodes.excerpt:
theorem ch_top {H : Type} [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {U0 : Type} [Fintype U0] {W : U0 → Type} [∀ u0, Fintype (W u0)] [∀ u0, Nonempty (W u0)]
    {Top : Type} [Fintype Top] {m f : ℕ} (Dd : Data U0 W Top m f) (tr : U0 → H) (C : Consts) (Xpp eK K : ℝ)
    (D : ArithData H) (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ)
    (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ) (eT : Top ≃ TT) (eP : Fin f ≃ PhiSet (H := H))
    (h1 : IdentU Dd tr D N ell TT a w eT eP) (h2 : SizeData₂ Dd C Xpp) (h3 : ErrWindows Dd C Xpp eK K) (h4 : BNBoundsU Dd T2)
    (h5 : LargeX Dd.x Dd.ε K C.cHH eK) (u : U0) :
    gapA D N ell TT a w (tr u) ≤
      Dd.x ^ (CErr C * Dd.ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a := by
  have hmain := ch_top_main_eq Dd tr D N ell TT a w eT eP h1 u
  have hask := h1.2.2.2.2 u
  have hgap : gapA D N ell TT a w (tr u) = Dd.ASK u - Dd.Main u := by
    rw [hask, hmain]
    unfold gapA
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6, s7, s8, s9, s10, s11⟩ := h2
  have hle := each_unit_bound_statement Dd C Xpp s1 s2 s3 s4 s5 s6 s7 s8 s9 s10 s11 u
  have herr := errX5at_le Dd C Xpp eK K h3 h5 u
  have hnT : Dd.nT = (TT.card : ℝ) := by
    unfold Data.nT
    have := Fintype.card_congr eT
    rw [Fintype.card_coe] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have htext : ErrText Dd ≤ errorBracketSizeWindows Dd.x Dd.ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m Dd.b Dd.k Dd.a := by
    unfold ErrText errorBracketSizeWindows
    rw [hnT]
    have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    gcongr
    · exact h4.1
    · exact h4.2
  have hpow : 0 ≤ Dd.x ^ (CErr C * Dd.ε) := Real.rpow_nonneg s1.1.le _
  rw [hgap]
  calc Dd.ASK u - Dd.Main u ≤ _ := by linarith
    _ ≤ _ := herr
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htext hpow

nodes.title: Average over characters
nodes.contract: Under the size and character hypotheses, per-index discrepancy bounds imply a power bound for GmA up to SigA.
nodes.idea: Character orthogonality and scale estimates convert the indexed bounds into a weighted average.
assumptions: a bound at every unit index
nodes.lean_head:
theorem ch_core (C ε CE Ko c M : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hε : 0 < ε) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : ∃ x1 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x1,
    ∀ (H : Type) [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (m : ℕ) (D : ArithData H) (S : Finset ℕ)
      (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ) (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ)
      (b b' k aE η X' θ : ℝ) (A0 : AddSubgroup H) (Kp : Finset (AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ)),
      HostFactsS D S → 0 < b → 0 ≤ aE → 0 < k → (m : ℝ) ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + ε / 2) → x * m ≤ k →
      SizesA A0 TT T2 a w N x b b' η X' θ → ThinScales D ell X' θ → CostWindows x (fPl H) b η θ →
      RestSize ε x (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE → (∀ s ∈ T2, s ∈ A0) → CharsA ell A0 Kp TT c M Ko CE ε x →
      (∀ u ∈ A0, gapA D N ell TT a w u ≤ x ^ (C * ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows x ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE) →
      GmA D ell Kp c x ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + (C + 3) * ε) + SigA D ell A0 Kp x

theorem ch_core (C ε CE Ko c M : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hε : 0 < ε) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : ∃ x1 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x1,
    ∀ (H : Type) [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (m : ℕ) (D : ArithData H) (S : Finset ℕ)
      (ell : AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (TT T2 : Finset H) (a : H → ℝ) (w : H → Fin m → E0 × H → ℝ)
      (b b' k aE η X' θ : ℝ) (A0 : AddSubgroup H) (Kp : Finset (AddChar (E0 × H) ℂ)),
      HostFactsS D S → 0 < b → 0 ≤ aE → 0 < k → (m : ℝ) ≤ x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 + ε / 2) → x * m ≤ k →
      SizesA A0 TT T2 a w N x b b' η X' θ → ThinScales D ell X' θ → CostWindows x (fPl H) b η θ →
      RestSize ε x (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE → (∀ s ∈ T2, s ∈ A0) → CharsA ell A0 Kp TT c M Ko CE ε x →
      (∀ u ∈ A0, gapA D N ell TT a w u ≤ x ^ (C * ε) * errorBracketSizeWindows x ε (Fintype.card H) TT.card T2.card m b k aE) →

nodes.title: The analytic criterion for a level
nodes.contract: For every level, every λ>1 and 0<θ<1, arbitrarily late windows bounded by x^θ imply no zero right of θ.
nodes.idea: Translate the level to a finite character family with positive weights. Apply the power-window theorem with δ=λ−1 and C=1.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem UpperTheory.Comparison₂.formB :
    ∀ Λ : Level, Λ.FormB
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.Comparison₂.formB :
    ∀ Λ : Level, Λ.FormB := by
  intro Λ la hla θ hθ0 hθ1 hW
  obtain ⟨F, hG, hZ⟩ := UpperTheory.Comparison₂.level_family Λ
  rw [← hZ]
  refine Deduction.zeroFree_of_rpow_window F (δ := la - 1) (C := 1) hθ0 hθ1 (by linarith) fun Y₀ => ?_
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hx⟩ := hW Y₀
  refine ⟨Y, hY, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) + (la - 1) = la := by ring
  rw [h1] at hy
  rw [hG, one_mul]
  exact hx y hy.1 hy.2

nodes.title: The character-family power-window theorem
nodes.contract: For a positive-weight family, a one-sided x^θ bound on arbitrarily late [Y,Y^(1+δ)] implies ZeroFree F θ.
nodes.idea: Pass to the weighted-integral formulation of the Landau window criterion.
assumptions: ∀ Y₀, ∃ Y≥Y₀, ∀ y∈[Y,Y^(1+δ)], Gm F y≤C y^θ
nodes.lean_head:
theorem zeroFree_of_rpow_window (F : CharFamily) {θ δ C : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ, ∃ Y : ℝ, Y₀ ≤ Y ∧ ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ)), Gm F y ≤ C * y ^ θ) :
    ZeroFree F θ
nodes.excerpt:
theorem zeroFree_of_rpow_window (F : CharFamily) {θ δ C : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : ∀ Y₀ : ℝ, ∃ Y : ℝ, Y₀ ≤ Y ∧ ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc Y (Y ^ (1 + δ)), Gm F y ≤ C * y ^ θ) :
    ZeroFree F θ :=
  lemmaL F hθ hθ1 hδ (windowHyp_of_rpow F hδ h)

nodes.title: Apply the pole obstruction
nodes.contract: WindowHyp on a finite character family implies ZeroFree F θ in the given parameter range.
nodes.idea: Build the pole data, exclude zeros in the strip by the window lemma, and use established nonvanishing at Re(s)≥1.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem lemmaL (F : CharFamily) {θ δ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : WindowHyp F θ δ) :
    ZeroFree F θ
nodes.excerpt:
theorem lemmaL (F : CharFamily) {θ δ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : WindowHyp F θ δ) :
    ZeroFree F θ := by
  intro i s hs hzero
  obtain ⟨Φ, hP⟩ := poleData F
  have hZ := landau_window hP hθ hθ1 hδ (windowHypU_of_windowHyp F hδ h)
  by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ s.re
  · exact charFamily_LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re F i s h1 hzero
  · have hmem : s ∈ zeroSet F := ⟨by linarith, i, Or.inl hzero⟩
    have := hZ s hmem
    linarith

nodes.title: Poles of the finite-family transform
nodes.contract: For each admissible finite family there exists a transform with PoleData for its zero set.
nodes.idea: Assemble individual character transforms and their pole data using positive weights.
assumptions: F : CharFamily, including positivity and principal-character convention
nodes.lean_head: theorem poleData (F : CharFamily) : ∃ Φ : ℂ → ℂ, PoleData (gm F) Φ (zeroSet F)
nodes.excerpt:
theorem poleData (F : CharFamily) : ∃ Φ : ℂ → ℂ, PoleData (gm F) Φ (zeroSet F) := by
  classical
  have adm' : ∀ i, F.N i = 1 ∨ (F.χ i)⁻¹ ≠ 1 := fun i => (F.adm i).imp id (fun h => inv_ne_one.mpr h)
  choose Φ1 hΦ1int hΦ1an hΦ1pol hΦ1iso using fun i => poleData_char (F.χ i) (F.adm i)
  choose Φ2 hΦ2int hΦ2an hΦ2pol hΦ2iso using fun i => poleData_char (F.χ i)⁻¹ (adm' i)
  choose C hC using fun i => Gchi_growth (F.χ i)
  have hZ : ∀ ρ, ρ ∈ zeroSet F ↔ 0 < ρ.re ∧ ∃ i, DirichletCharacter.LFunction (F.χ i) ρ = 0 ∨
      DirichletCharacter.LFunction (F.χ i) ((starRingEnd ℂ) ρ) = 0 := by
    intro ρ
    rw [zeroSet.eq_1]
    rfl
  have hconj : ∀ i (w : ℂ), DirichletCharacter.LFunction (F.χ i) ((starRingEnd ℂ) w) = 0 ↔

nodes.title: Rule out a pole right of θ
nodes.contract: For the supplied PoleData and WindowHypU, any ρ in the specified pole set satisfies Re(ρ)≤θ.
nodes.idea: Use high derivatives to compare a window upper bound with growth from an isolated pole.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem landau_window {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {Z : Set ℂ} (hP : PoleData g Φ Z) {θ δ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hW : WindowHypU g θ δ) : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re ≤ θ
nodes.excerpt:
theorem landau_window {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {Z : Set ℂ} (hP : PoleData g Φ Z) {θ δ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hW : WindowHypU g θ δ) : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re ≤ θ := by
  intro ρ₀ h₀
  by_contra hρ₀
  rw [not_le] at hρ₀
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, C, hkey⟩ := landau_window_key hP hθ hθ1 hδ hW
  have hle : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re < σ := fun ρ hρ => (landau_pole_re_le hP ρ hρ).trans_lt hσ
  rcases landau_dichotomy hP.iso hle hθ (by linarith) h₀ hρ₀ with
    ⟨D, hD, hfree, ρ₁, h₁, hρ₁⟩ | ⟨β, hβZ, hβ, r, hr1, hr2, huniq⟩
  · obtain ⟨γ, ρ, hρ, r, hr1, hr2, huniq⟩ := landau_nearest hP.iso hle (by linarith : D < σ) h₁ hρ₁
    obtain ⟨c, hc, -, hp⟩ := hP.pole ρ hρ
    set z : ℂ := (σ : ℂ) + γ * I with hz
    have hzre : z.re = σ := by simp [hz]

nodes.title: A second zeta deduction
nodes.contract: EveryCharacter implies Mathlib RH.
nodes.idea: The alternate argument reflects completed zeta. The two zeta exports in Main use the other reducer.
nodes.lean_head: theorem UpperTheory.riemannHypothesis_of_everyCharacter (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : RiemannHypothesis
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.riemannHypothesis_of_everyCharacter (h : UpperTheory.EveryCharacter) : RiemannHypothesis := by
  intro s hs hn h1
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [riemannZeta_zero] at hs; norm_num at hs
    have h1s : (1 - s) ≠ 1 := fun e => hs0 (by simpa using e)
    have hz : riemannZeta (1 - s) ≠ 0 := UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h (1 - s) (by simp; linarith) h1s
    have hc : completedRiemannZeta s = completedRiemannZeta (1 - s) := (completedRiemannZeta_one_sub s).symm
    have h1s0 : (1 - s) ≠ 0 := fun e => h1 (by linear_combination -e)
    rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact hz (by rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero h1s0, ← hc, hs, zero_div])
    · obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.1 hs
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact hs0 (by simpa using hn')
      · exact hn ⟨n, by rw [hn']; push_cast; ring⟩
  · exact UpperTheory.zeta_ne_zero_of_everyCharacter h s hgt h1 hs

nodes.title: The geometric ranks

nodes.idea: The precise fixed-epsilon rank scale is x^(1/2−ε/16).

nodes.excerpt:
def RankVal (s : Scale) (R : Ranks) : Prop :=
  (s.x ^ (2 + 8 * s.eps) ≤ (R.n : ℝ) ∧ (R.n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * s.x ^ (2 + 8 * s.eps)) ∧
  (Real.sqrt (s.x * s.delta1) ≤ (R.m : ℝ) ∧ (R.m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (s.x * s.delta1)) ∧

  R.r + R.t = 8 * R.f * R.r + 4 + TOv s * nWv R s

nodes.title: A local source of divisibility
nodes.contract: For w²=p and the displayed congruences, w divides a two-by-two minor.
nodes.idea: In the quotient by w the two transformed rows are multiples of one row. Their minor vanishes.
assumptions: both input rows supported in position zero modulo w
nodes.lean_head:
theorem key_minor_dvd {A : Type} [CommRing A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (w : A) (hw : w ^ 2 = (p : A)) (k e : ℕ)
    (u u' : Fin (k + 1) → A) (M N' : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → A)
    (hMN : ∀ b a, ∃ T, M b a ^ (p ^ e) = N' b a + p * T)
    (hu : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u b) (hu' : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u' b) (c : Fin (k + 1)) :
    w ∣ (∑ b, u' b * N' b c) * (∑ b, u b * M b 0) ^ (p ^ e) - (∑ b, u' b * N' b 0) * (∑ b, u b * M b c) ^ (p ^ e)
nodes.excerpt:
theorem key_minor_dvd {A : Type} [CommRing A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (w : A) (hw : w ^ 2 = (p : A)) (k e : ℕ)
    (u u' : Fin (k + 1) → A) (M N' : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → A)
    (hMN : ∀ b a, ∃ T, M b a ^ (p ^ e) = N' b a + p * T)
    (hu : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u b) (hu' : ∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ u' b) (c : Fin (k + 1)) :
    w ∣ (∑ b, u' b * N' b c) * (∑ b, u b * M b 0) ^ (p ^ e) - (∑ b, u' b * N' b 0) * (∑ b, u b * M b c) ^ (p ^ e) := by

  apply (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w _).mp
  set φ := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {w}) with hφ
  have hw0 : φ w = 0 := (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w w).mpr dvd_rfl
  have hp0 : φ (p : A) = 0 := by rw [← hw, map_pow, hw0, zero_pow two_ne_zero]
  have hrow : ∀ (x : Fin (k + 1) → A) (Q : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → A), (∀ b, b ≠ 0 → w ∣ x b) →
      ∀ a, φ (∑ b, x b * Q b a) = φ (x 0) * φ (Q 0 a) := by
    intro x Q hx a
    have hz : ∀ i : Fin k, φ (x i.succ) = 0 := fun i =>
      (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd w _).mpr (hx _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _))
    rw [map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, map_mul]
    simp [hz]
  have hpow : ∀ a, φ (M 0 a) ^ (p ^ e) = φ (N' 0 a) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hMN 0 a
    rw [← map_pow, hT, map_add, map_mul, hp0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hrow u' N' hu' c, hrow u M hu 0, hrow u' N' hu' 0,
    hrow u M hu c, mul_pow, mul_pow, hpow 0, hpow c]
  ring

lemma noRel_image (L S d k : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :

nodes.title: An existence check on a period identity
nodes.contract: At a suitable intermediate stage there exists v≠0 such that level volume times character weight equals v at every admissible datum.

nodes.lean_head: theorem volLev_mul_wt_mid_alt : ∀ {B : GlobalTheory.Mem.Base} {X : PreX B.toPre} {I : TC B X} {l : I.Laws} {Z : TC.Later B (I.cols l)} {L : SizeData₂ (I.rec7 l Z)} {hT : GatTies (I.rec7 l Z)} {Gi : Formalism.MainNotions.G.Inst (I.rec7 l Z) L} {Gl : Formalism.MainNotions.G.LatInst (I.rec7 l Z)} {Kc : Formalism.MainNotions.G.Consts} {Yd : DivX (I.rec7 l Z)} {cX : ExtraC} {ex : Extra (I.rec7 l Z) L hT Gi Gl Kc Yd cX} (W : _root_.GlobalTheory.MiS.RealPackAlt ex), _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.AllFamilyConditions W → ∀ (u : B.Word) (a : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.GeometricFamily W u), a.Is → a.True → ∀ j, j + 2 ≤ B.R.m → ∃ v : ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ t (J : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.QuadraticExtensionData a t), J.Reads → ∀ α, (GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) : ℂ) * J.wt j α = v
nodes.excerpt:
theorem volLev_mul_wt_mid_alt : ∀ {B : GlobalTheory.Mem.Base} {X : PreX B.toPre} {I : TC B X} {l : I.Laws} {Z : TC.Later B (I.cols l)} {L : SizeData₂ (I.rec7 l Z)} {hT : GatTies (I.rec7 l Z)} {Gi : Formalism.MainNotions.G.Inst (I.rec7 l Z) L} {Gl : Formalism.MainNotions.G.LatInst (I.rec7 l Z)} {Kc : Formalism.MainNotions.G.Consts} {Yd : DivX (I.rec7 l Z)} {cX : ExtraC} {ex : Extra (I.rec7 l Z) L hT Gi Gl Kc Yd cX} (W : _root_.GlobalTheory.MiS.RealPackAlt ex), _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.AllFamilyConditions W → ∀ (u : B.Word) (a : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.GeometricFamily W u), a.Is → a.True → ∀ j, j + 2 ≤ B.R.m → ∃ v : ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ t (J : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.QuadraticExtensionData a t), J.Reads → ∀ α, (GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) : ℂ) * J.wt j α = v := by
  intro B X I l Z L hT Gi Gl Kc Yd cX ex W hW u a ha haT j hj
  obtain ⟨Up, hUpf, hUpc, hK⟩ := _root_.GlobalTheory.T.true_geometry_step_value_alt W hW u a ha haT j hj
  have step : ∀ t (J : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.QuadraticExtensionData a t), J.Reads → ∀ α : J.Ch j,
      (GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) : ℂ) * J.wt j α = (GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol Up : ℂ) ∧
        J.wt j α ≠ 0 ∧ GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro t J hJ α
    obtain ⟨H, φ, hH, hφK, hφs, hU⟩ := hK t J hJ α
    have hidx := relIndex_eq_prod_of_pi φ Up (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) (fun i => KO (J.G i).k _) H hφK hφs hU
    have hreps := (GlobalTheory.T.chartLevels_reps_represent_unitaryDoubleCosets I hW.tr.ok hW.tr.pins.some l Z u (W.P.I.tup t) J.Ch₀ J.A hJ.is j (by omega) (J.ι j α)).1
    have hvol := GlobalTheory.T.archimedeanLevelVolume_mul_relIndex (I.rec7 l Z) _ (a.g.x j).vol (J.A.U j (J.ι j α)) Up (fun g hg => ((hU g).1 hg).1) hUpf hUpc
      hreps.opn
    have hwt : J.wt j α = ((J.A.U j (J.ι j α)).relIndex Up : ℂ) := by
      rw [hidx, _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.QuadraticExtensionData.wt]
      push_cast
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [(hH i).2.2.2]
      exact GlobalTheory.T.inv_haarVolume_toReal_eq_relIndex_integral (J.G i) _ (J.E i) j (H i) (hH i).1 (hH i).2.1 (hH i).2.2.1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, GlobalTheory.AdForm.PinInhab.volLev_ne_zero hW.tr.ok haT.pinX.inf j _ _ hreps⟩
    · rw [hwt, ← hvol]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [hwt, hidx]; push_cast; exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ => by exact_mod_cast (hH i).2.2.1
  by_cases hex : ∃ t, ∃ J : _root_.GlobalTheory.Fam.QuadraticExtensionData a t, J.Reads ∧ Nonempty (J.Ch j)
  · obtain ⟨t, J, hJ, ⟨α⟩⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨GlobalTheory.SeeSaw.volLev (a.g.x j).vol Up, ?_, fun t' J' hJ' α' => (step t' J' hJ' α').1⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := step t J hJ α
    rw [← h1]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast h3) h2
  · exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, fun t J hJ α => absurd ⟨t, J, hJ, ⟨α⟩⟩ hex⟩

nodes.title: The lattice slope inequality
nodes.contract: The sublattice bound SlopeLeMuMax implies SlopeInequality for injective norm-bounded lattice maps.
nodes.idea: A Gram determinant bounds the image covolume by C to the rank times the source covolume.
assumptions: SlopeLeMuMax; in the result, discrete lattices, nonzero source, injectivity and norm bound C
nodes.lean_head: theorem slopeInequality_of (h : SlopeLeMuMax.{v}) : SlopeInequality.{u, v}
nodes.excerpt:
theorem slopeInequality_of (h : SlopeLeMuMax.{v}) : SlopeInequality.{u, v} := by
  intro E F _ _ _ _ _ _ L M hL hM hne φ C hφ hC
  classical
  let g : L →ₗ[ℤ] F := M.subtype.comp φ
  have ginj : Function.Injective g := M.injective_subtype.comp hφ
  let N : Submodule ℤ F := LinearMap.range g
  have hNM : N ≤ M := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (φ x).2
  haveI : DiscreteTopology L := hL
  haveI : DiscreteTopology M := hM
  haveI : DiscreteTopology N :=
    DiscreteTopology.of_continuous_injective (continuous_inclusion hNM)
      (Submodule.inclusion_injective hNM)
  let e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N := LinearEquiv.ofInjective g ginj

  have hCKpos : (0 : ℝ) < max CK0 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hCK1

    ∃ (_ : Fact l.Prime) (L₀ : Type) (_ : Field L₀) (_ : NumberField L₀), IsAbField A L₀ ∧ ABound l R L₀
  let R0 : AbF → ℕ := fun M => Classical.choose (hT M)
  let Rl : ℕ → AbF → ℕ := fun l A => if h : ∃ R, P l A R then Classical.choose h else 0
  refine ⟨BConst.mk R0 Rl (max CK0 1) hCKpos, fun Ct hCt => ?_⟩
  unfold ThmBab BShape IsBWindow
  intro M B' L hAux eps A1 heps heps'
  unfold OddPrimesWithRootsOfUnity at hAux
  have hCt0 : 0 < Ct := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hCt
  set CK : ℝ := max CK0 1 with hCKdef
  set R : ℕ := R0 M + ∑ l ∈ B', Rl l (L l) with hRdef
  set J : ℝ := 2 ^ (R + 2) * (2 * CK * Ct / eps) ^ R with hJdef
  have hJpos : 0 < J := by
    have : 0 < 2 * CK * Ct / eps := by positivity
    positivity
  obtain ⟨x0A, hA⟩ := partA CK hCKpos hK M (R0 M) J Ct eps A1 hJpos hCt0.le heps
  have hB : ∀ l ∈ B', ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ e t, admitted A1 Ct e t → ∀ X : ℝ, ∃ Exc : Finset ℕ,
      Exc.card ≤ Rl l (L l) ∧ ∀ x ≥ x0, X ^ (1 / J) ≤ x → x ≤ X → Good (eps / (2 * CK)) Ct Exc x →
        ∀ (_ : Fact l.Prime) (L₀' : Type) [Field L₀'] [NumberField L₀'], IsAbField (L l) L₀' →
          ∀ (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀' L₁],
            IsLayer l (Nat.log l (Rl l (L l)) + 3) L₀' L₁ → VVat l L₁ (t x) (Real.exp (x ^ (4 * eps / 5))) := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨hp, hl2, hmu⟩ := hAux l hl
    haveI : Fact l.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    by_cases hex : ∃ (L₀ : Type) (_ : Field L₀) (_ : NumberField L₀), IsAbField (L l) L₀
    · obtain ⟨L₀, _, _, hab⟩ := hex
      have hP : ∃ R, P l (L l) R := by
        obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := hF l hl2 (L l) hmu L₀ hab
        exact ⟨R', ⟨_, L₀, _, _, hab, hR'⟩⟩
      have hRl : Rl l (L l) = Classical.choose hP := by
        show (if h : ∃ R, P l (L l) R then Classical.choose h else 0) = _
        rw [dif_pos hP]
      obtain ⟨_, L₀₀, _, _, hab0, hR0⟩ := Classical.choose_spec hP
      obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := partB CK hCKpos hK l (Classical.choose hP) hl2 (L l) hmu L₀₀ hab0 hR0
        J Ct eps A1 hJpos hCt0.le heps
      refine ⟨x0, fun e t hAdm X => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨Exc, hcard, hx⟩ := hx0 e t hAdm X
      refine ⟨Exc, hRl ▸ hcard, fun x hxx hlo hhi hg _ L₀' _ _ hab' L₁ _ _ _ hlay => ?_⟩
      rw [hRl] at hlay
      exact hx x hxx hlo hhi hg L₀' hab' L₁ hlay
    · refine ⟨0, fun e t _ X => ⟨∅, by simp, ?_⟩⟩
      intro x _ _ _ _ _ L₀' _ _ hab' _ _ _ _ _
      exact absurd ⟨L₀', _, _, hab'⟩ hex
  choose! f hf using hB
  set x1 : ℝ := max 1 (max x0A (∑ l ∈ B', |f l|)) with hx1def
  have hfle : ∀ l ∈ B', f l ≤ x1 := fun l hl =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (f i)) hl).trans
      ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hx0A : x0A ≤ x1 := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hx1pos : 0 ≤ x1 := zero_le_one.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨max 2 (x1 ^ J), fun e t hAdm X hX q d hqd hlog => ?_⟩
  have hX2 : 2 ≤ X := (le_max_left _ _).trans hX
  have hXJ : x1 ^ J ≤ X := (le_max_right _ _).trans hX
  have hlow : x1 ≤ X ^ (1 / J) := by
    calc x1 = (x1 ^ J) ^ (1 / J) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx1pos, mul_one_div_cancel hJpos.ne', Real.rpow_one]
      _ ≤ X ^ (1 / J) := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx1pos _) hXJ (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨L₀, _, _, hTB, hAB⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hT M) q d hqd
  obtain ⟨ExcA, hcardA, hxA⟩ := hA e t hAdm X q d hqd hlog L₀ hTB hAB
  have hB2 := fun l hl => hf l hl e t hAdm X
  choose! g hg using hB2
  have hcard : (ExcA ∪ B'.biUnion g).card ≤ R :=
    (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hcardA
      (Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun l hl => (hg l hl).1)))
  have heta : 0 < eps / (2 * CK) := by positivity
  have hetaCt : eps / (2 * CK) ≤ Ct := by
    have h1 : eps / (2 * CK) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
    linarith
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hgood⟩ := window R (eps / (2 * CK)) Ct X (ExcA ∪ B'.biUnion g) heta hetaCt
    (by linarith) hcard
  have hJeq : (2 : ℝ) ^ (R + 2) * (Ct / (eps / (2 * CK))) ^ R = J := by
    rw [hJdef, show Ct / (eps / (2 * CK)) = 2 * CK * Ct / eps by rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]; ring]
  rw [hJeq] at hY
  refine ⟨Y, hY, fun x hYx hxY => ?_⟩
  have hG := hgood x hYx hxY
  have hXlo : X ^ (1 / J) ≤ x := hY.1.trans hYx
  have hXhi : x ≤ X := hxY.trans hY.2
  have hGsub : ∀ S ⊆ ExcA ∪ B'.biUnion g, Good (eps / (2 * CK)) Ct S x :=
    fun S hS n hn => hG n (hS hn)
  refine ⟨hxA x (hx0A.trans (hlow.trans hXlo)) hXlo hXhi (hGsub _ Finset.subset_union_left), ?_⟩
  unfold BbAt
  intro l hl _ L₀' _ _ hab L₁ _ _ _ hlay
  exact (hg l hl).2 x ((hfle l hl).trans (hlow.trans hXlo)) hXlo hXhi
    (hGsub _ ((Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem g hl).trans Finset.subset_union_right)) _ L₀' hab L₁ hlay

nodes.title: From a finitely generated tower to two length bounds
nodes.contract: For each prime and eligible tower, ABound consists of a bound away from finitely many centres and a bound in terms of a fixed layer.
nodes.idea: Choose a Galois element generating the cyclotomic direction, prove the descent equality for its twists, and apply the two cokernel estimates on the tower module.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
A totally complex cyclotomic tower base with the prescribed roots and at most R generators

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_isTower (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK)

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_isTower (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK)

nodes.title: Control exceptional twists by the fixed layer
nodes.contract: The lengths are controlled by at most R ℓ-adic centres. For all twists they are also bounded by the fixed-layer H² length plus R times the excess layer index.
nodes.idea: Use unipotence modulo ℓ and the generator bound for the centres. The relative growth estimate can allow infinite length at a singular twist. Descent and duality bound the reference value by the arithmetic H² length.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
A generator with the stated cyclotomic valuation, roots and descent identity
nodes.excerpt:
theorem aBound_of_descends (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK) {R c : ℕ}
    (ht : IsTower l L₀ R) {γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀)} (hu : IsLevel l (cycZ L₀ _ l γ : ℤ_[l]) c)
    (hc : ∃ ζ : L₀, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) (h : Descends l L₀ γ) : Win.ABound l R L₀ := by
  have hX : GenBy l R (XP l L₀) := ht.gen
  have hγ := xUnip L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀) l l ⊤ isClosed_univ ht.gen.finite γ (mem_levU_one (lteNorm l _ c hu).2.1)
  refine ⟨?_, fun e he m L₁ _ _ _ h₁ L₂ _ _ _ h₂ Ω _ _ _ D => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_centres_norm hX hγ hu
    refine ⟨ℚ_[l], inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, c, R, fun i => s i, le_rfl, hc,
      fun e he m L₁ _ _ _ h₁ B hB => ?_⟩
    rw [h.eq_twLen he h₁]
    refine hs e m B fun i => (hB i).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [PadicInt.norm_def]
    push_cast
    rfl
  · haveI := ht.complex
    haveI : IsTotallyComplex L₂ := isTotallyComplex_of_algebra L₀ L₂
    rw [h.eq_twLen he h₁]
    refine (twLen_le_growth hX hγ hu e m).trans (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)
    rw [← h.eq_twLen he (m := jZero l R) h₂, ← shaLen_eq_shaInv D]
    exact shaLeV hP hF hT L₂ Ω l (ptCase_of_isTotallyComplex L₂ l) D e

nodes.title: Uniform ℓ-rank of class groups in the tower
nodes.contract: For each eligible abelian base K and prime ℓ there is an exponent r bounding the order of the quotient by ℓ-th powers by ℓʳ on every cyclotomic layer.
nodes.idea: Embed the abelian base into a cyclotomic field. Use the cyclotomic index estimate and descend across a uniformly bounded degree. The root-of-unity premise in the published interface is unused by this proof.
nodes.lean_head: theorem UpperTheory.V.FW.ferreroWashington : UpperTheory.V.Published.FerreroWashington
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.V.FW.ferreroWashington : UpperTheory.V.Published.FerreroWashington := by
  unfold UpperTheory.V.Published.FerreroWashington
  intro l _ K _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨f, D, hf, h1, hemb⟩ := embed l K
  obtain ⟨B, n₀, hB⟩ := cyc l f hf h1
  refine ⟨D * l ^ n₀ * B, ?_⟩
  intro n K' _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨m, L, iF, iN, iA, iC, hm, hdeg⟩ := hemb n n₀ K'
  obtain ⟨htc, hidx⟩ := hB m hm L
  have hd := desc l K' L htc
  have hl2 : 1 < l := (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt
  have key : Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K') ⧸ (powMonoidHom l).range) ≤ D * l ^ n₀ * B := by
    have e : Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K') ⧸ (powMonoidHom l).range) = (powR (Cl K') l).index := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact hd.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul hdeg hidx)
  exact key.trans (Nat.lt_pow_self hl2).le

nodes.contract: For a fixed imaginary quadratic field, twist, character kernel and admissible auxiliary prime, one nonzero integer gives a logarithmic size bound and simultaneous valuation bounds at the other eligible primes.
nodes.idea: Make a Galois-stable family of characters with the chosen kernel. A trace product supplies the integer before the coefficient prime is chosen. Rigidity bounds the sum of the orbit lengths by twice its valuation.

    _root_.UpperTheory.V.Z.J.NumberU3U_s → _root_.UpperTheory.V.Z.J.OneCharU_s → PropGK
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Z.J.propGK_of_numberU3U_of_oneCharU :

  haveI : Fintype {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // χ.toUnitHom.ker = H} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨NN, h0, hsz, hdiv⟩ := hC e he N (NeZero.pos N) p w hp hw h7 hN hd
    {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N // χ.toUnitHom.ker = H} (fun χ => (χ.1 (normV w))⁻¹)

      rw [inv_pow, ← ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime _ (cop_norm hp hN hw), ← MulChar.pow_apply_coe, pow_orderOf_eq_one,

      fun χ => Subtype.ext (MulChar.ext' fun a => σ.apply_symm_apply _)⟩, fun χ => (map_inv₀ σ _).symm⟩)

  · have := card_orb H

    have hl := Real.log_natCast_nonneg p

  obtain ⟨ψ₀, h₀, hψ₀⟩ := h

  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K Ω := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := ℚ) K

  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := orb_equiv c H (ι.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap c.O (PadicAlgCl l)))
    (ι.injective.comp Subtype.val_injective) h₀
  obtain ⟨f1, f2⟩ := frob_val hp hN hlp hw hB hσ
  have key := fun ψ : orb c H => hOne Ω K l c N e ψ.1
    ((gdFacts Ω K l e c.O N ψ₀ hψ₀).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ψ.1 (((mem_orb c).1 ψ.2).trans ((mem_orb c).1 h₀).symm)).1 ι σ⁻¹
    (ι.symm (Af.eis3 (normV w) e ((E ψ).1 (normV w))⁻¹))
    (by rw [hE, map_inv (galEmb ℚ K Ω)]; exact t_eq c e _ ψ.1 ι _ f1 f2)
    (fun ρ hρ => (hD (fun _ => {ρ}) (fun _ ρ' h => by rwa [Finset.mem_singleton.1 h])
      (fun _ a ha b hb _ => (Finset.mem_singleton.1 ha).trans (Finset.mem_singleton.1 hb).symm)).1 (E ψ) ρ
      (Finset.mem_singleton_self ρ))
