  choose X hX1 hX2 hX3 using fun ψ => (key ψ).2
  obtain ⟨hne, hle⟩ := hD (fun o => X (E.symm o)) (fun o => hX1 _) (fun o => hX2 _)
  have hb := vl_bound _ _ NN h0 (fun o ρ hρ => sub_ne_zero.2 (hne o ρ hρ)) hle
  rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun ψ _ => hX3 ψ).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_eq_of_le ?_ hb) zero_le_two
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv E _ _ fun ψ => by rw [E.symm_apply_apply]

nodes.title: Convert the joint window into VWin
nodes.contract: The tower window, sign bounds and five counting inputs yield VWin, the cohomology estimate for each primitive character at cutoff exponent 401.
nodes.idea: Obtain a common tower and positive-part window, convert the negative-part bound at exponent 401, and combine the contributions on the same interval.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
CountI, II, III, V and Z
nodes.excerpt:
theorem vwin_of_counts (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK) {CK : ℝ}
    (hK : LemmaK CK) {K : BConst} (hB : ThmBab K 401) (hc : ThmBcFree) (h1 : CountI) (h2 : CountII) (h3 : CountIII)
    (h5 : CountV) (hZ : CountZ) : VWin :=
  vwin_of_joint (jointWin_of_counts hP hF hT hK hB h1 h2 h3 h5 hZ) ((thmBc_iff (by norm_num)).2 hc)

nodes.title: Reuse the tower interval for the positive part
nodes.contract: For each eligible choice of character and parameters, one interval satisfies both the tower and positive-part bounds at every point.
nodes.idea: Apply the height estimate to the very interval selected by ThmBab. Its universal quantifier over accepted windows permits this reuse.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
CountI, II, III, V and Z
nodes.excerpt:
theorem jointWin_of_counts (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK) {CK : ℝ}
    (hK : LemmaK CK) {K : BConst} (hB : ThmBab K 401) (h1 : CountI) (h2 : CountII) (h3 : CountIII) (h5 : CountV)
    (hZ : CountZ) : JointWin 401 :=
  jointWin_of (by norm_num) hB (thmHV_of_counts hP hF hT hK h1 h2 h3 h5 hZ K (by norm_num))

nodes.title: Evaluate the pointwise estimate on admissible windows
nodes.contract: Every package K and positive cutoff exponent Ct satisfy the positive-part height theorem under the stated counting and cohomology inputs.
nodes.idea: First prove the estimate with layer bounds as hypotheses. The height theorem specializes it using the supplied interval, the primes, the cutoff and the very same field.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
CountI, II, III, V and Z

nodes.title: Combine the two prime sums at a point
nodes.contract: After the character and layer indices are fixed, one polynomial bound controls the positive cohomological sum on eligible hosts, with an additive multiple of the layer budget.
nodes.idea: Form separate sums inside and outside the fixed exceptional set. Inside, the dispatcher also supplies Case IV and the strict-threshold case Vs. Add the two estimates using the same host and layer budget.
assumptions: Global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality
CountI, II, III, V and Z

theorem pointHV_of_counts (hP : GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality) (hF : LocalFinitenessK) (hT : LocalTateDualityK) {CK : ℝ}
    (hK : LemmaK CK) (h1 : CountI) (h2 : CountII) (h3 : CountIII) (h5 : CountV) (hZ : CountZ) : PointHV

nodes.title: Add contributions inside the exceptional set
nodes.contract: For fixed character, exceptional coefficient prime and layer index, the positive-part sum at that prime is at most (Nt)^C + C·B when the fixed layer satisfies its budget B.
nodes.idea: Separate the twist-one threshold from the higher twists. For the odd-order branch, Case IV uses the supplied layer bound. Absorb the finite character contributions into a common exponent.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem UpperTheory.V.HV.sumIn :
    CountII → CountV → CountVs → CountIV → SumIn
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.V.HV.sumIn :
    CountII → CountV → CountVs → CountIV → SumIn := by
  unfold SumIn
  intro hII hV hVs hIV χ l j hl
  haveI : Fact (l : ℕ).Prime := ⟨l.2⟩
  haveI : IsAlgClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) := by
    convert (AlgebraicClosure.instIsAlgClosure (k := ℚ))
    · rfl
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hII χ
  obtain ⟨C5, hC5⟩ := hV χ
  obtain ⟨C6, hC6⟩ := hVs χ
  obtain ⟨C4, hC4⟩ := hIV χ (l : ℕ) j hl
  set Cm := max C2 (max C5 C6) with hCm
  refine ⟨C4 + 2 * Cm + 9 + (l : ℕ) * χ.N, ?_⟩
  intro h hχ t ht2 hBig B hB hLay E _ _ _ hE Ω _ _ _ ld
  classical
  haveI : NeZero h.N := ⟨h.N_pos.ne'⟩
  haveI : NeZero (Nat.totient h.N) := ⟨(Nat.totient_pos.2 h.N_pos).ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_coef (l : ℕ) (Nat.totient h.N)
  haveI := hc
  have hlp : (l : ℕ).Prime := l.2
  have hl2 : (l : ℕ) ≠ 2 := (prime_of_mem_Bchi hl).2
  have hlB : (l : ℕ) ∈ Bchi h.chi := by
    rw [hχ]
    exact hl
  have hbf := bchiFacts h t hBig
  have hlq1 : (l : ℕ) < h.q1 := (hbf.1 _ hlB).1
  have hld : (l : ℕ) < h.d := (hbf.1 _ hlB).2
  have hidx := hostIndex h
  have hNpos : 0 < h.N := h.N_pos
  have hq1N : h.q1 ≤ h.N := Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos h.host_q1_dvd_N
  have hqN : h.q ≤ h.N := Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos h.q_dvd
  have h16 : 16 ≤ h.N := Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos hidx.2.2.1
  have hlN : (l : ℕ) ≤ h.N := by omega
  set M : ℝ := (h.N : ℝ) * t with hMdef
  set L : ℝ := Real.log ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) with hLdef
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h.N := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ h.N)
  have hM3 : 3 ≤ M := by
    have a1 : (16 : ℝ) ≤ h.N := by exact_mod_cast h16
    have a2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast ht2
    rw [hMdef]
    nlinarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
  have hl1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlp.one_lt.le
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := Real.log_nonneg hl1
  have hLl : L ≤ ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith
  have hNM : (h.N : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    have a2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ t)
    rw [hMdef]
    nlinarith
  have hlM : ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hlN) hNM
  have hqM : (h.q : ℝ) ≤ M := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hqN) hNM
  have hKb : ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → ∀ k ≤ Cm, (((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e) ^ k ≤ (M ^ 2) ^ Cm := by
    intro e he0 het k hk
    have he1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast he0
    have het' : (e : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast het.le
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e := by
      have a1 : 1 ≤ ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have hx2 : ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e ≤ M ^ 2 := by
      have a1 : (h.N : ℝ) * e ≤ M := by
        rw [hMdef]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left het' (by linarith)
      calc ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e = ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * (h.N * e) := by ring
        _ ≤ M * M := mul_le_mul hlM a1 (by positivity) hM0
        _ = M ^ 2 := by ring
    calc (((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e) ^ k ≤ (((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * h.N * e) ^ Cm := pow_le_pow_right₀ hx1 hk
      _ ≤ (M ^ 2) ^ Cm := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hx2 Cm
  let Oset : Finset (DirichletCharacter c.O h.N) :=
    (Finset.Ico 1 t).biUnion (fun e => (h.X c e).filter (fun ψ => Odd (orderOf (chiP (l : ℕ) ψ))))
  have hkey : ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → ∀ ψ ∈ h.X c e,
      Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ ≠ ⊤ ∧
        (ψ ∈ Oset ∨ Chr.nrm (l : ℕ) c.O (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ) * L ≤ (M ^ 2) ^ Cm) := by
    intro e he0 het ψ hψ
    have hchar := ((Host.mem_X h).1 hψ).1
    rcases (UpperTheory.V.HV.cases h t hBig c.O ψ hchar (l : ℕ) e hlp hl2 he0 het).2 hlB with hc2 | hc4 | hc5
    · have hv := hC2 h hχ t hBig (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (l : ℕ) c e hl2 he0 het ψ hψ hc2
      exact ⟨hv.1, Or.inr (hv.2.trans (hKb e he0 het C2 (le_max_left _ _)))⟩
    · have hs := hC4 h hχ t ht2 hBig B hLay (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c ψ hchar hc4.2.2
      refine ⟨hs.1 e he0 het, Or.inl ?_⟩
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨e, Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨he0, het⟩, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hψ, hc4.2.2⟩⟩
    · by_cases hR : h.R1 (l : ℕ) ψ ≤ 2 ^ c2 ψ
      · have hv := hC5 h hχ t hBig (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (l : ℕ) c e hl2 he0 het ψ hψ ⟨hc5, hR⟩
        exact ⟨hv.1, Or.inr (hv.2.trans (hKb e he0 het C5 (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))⟩
      · have hv := hC6 h hχ t hBig (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (l : ℕ) c e hl2 he0 het ψ hψ ⟨hc5, not_le.1 hR⟩
        exact ⟨hv.1, Or.inr (hv.2.trans (hKb e he0 het C6 (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))⟩
  have hOcard : Oset.card ≤ h.q := by
    apply (xCard c.O h.N).2 h.q (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h.chi.ne.out) Oset
    intro ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨e, -, hψ'⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hψ
    obtain ⟨hX, hodd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hψ'
    exact ((hostOdd h c.O ψ ((Host.mem_X h).1 hX).1).2 (l : ℕ) hlp hl2 hlq1.ne hld.ne hodd).1
  have hO2 : ∀ ψ ∈ Oset, ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, Chr.nrm (l : ℕ) c.O (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ) ≤ B + M ^ C4 := by
    intro ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨e, -, hψ'⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hψ
    obtain ⟨hX, hodd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hψ'
    exact (hC4 h hχ t ht2 hBig B hLay (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c ψ ((Host.mem_X h).1 hX).1 hodd).2
  have hXsub : ∀ e, h.X c e ⊆ h.X c 0 ∪ h.X c 1 := by
    intro e ψ hψ
    rw [Host.mem_X] at hψ
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Host.mem_X, Host.mem_X]
    have h2 := hψ.2
    unfold PsiEven at h2
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd e with he | he
    · left
      refine ⟨hψ.1, ?_⟩
      unfold PsiEven
      rw [h2, he.neg_one_pow, pow_zero]
    · right
      refine ⟨hψ.1, ?_⟩
      unfold PsiEven
      rw [h2, he.neg_one_pow, pow_one]
  have hred : ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → plusLen (ld (l : ℕ)) e * eO (l : ℕ) c.O ≤
      ∑ ψ ∈ h.X c e, (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ + (lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ∞) * eO (l : ℕ) c.O) := by
    intro e he0 het
    exact redAll E h.N h.H (hostLevel h E (by rw [hχ]; exact hE)) (l : ℕ) hl2 c Ω (ld (l : ℕ)) (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) e he0.ne' (h.X c e)
      (by
        ext ψ
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Host.mem_X]
        rfl)
  have hsb := Chr.sumBack (l : ℕ) c.O (DirichletCharacter c.O h.N) (fun e => h.X c e) (h.X c 0 ∪ h.X c 1)
    (fun ψ e => Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ) (fun e => plusLen (ld (l : ℕ)) e)
    (fun e => lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e) t hXsub
    (fun e he0 het => ⟨fun ψ hψ => (hkey e he0 het ψ hψ).1, hred e he0 het⟩)
  have hA : (∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((plusLen (ld (l : ℕ)) e).toNat : ℝ)) ≤
      (∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ∑ ψ ∈ h.X c e, Chr.nrm (l : ℕ) c.O (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ)) +
        ((h.X c 0 ∪ h.X c 1).card : ℝ) * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) := hsb.2
  have hloss : ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ t * M ^ 6 := by
    calc ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, M ^ 6 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro e he
          obtain ⟨he1, het⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 he
          have hb := (lossLe (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e hlp hl2 (by omega) hidx.2.1 he1).1
          have hb' : ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (((h.N * e) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast hb
          have het' : (e : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast het.le
          calc ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (((h.N * e) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hb'
            _ = ((h.N : ℝ) * e) ^ 6 := by push_cast; ring
            _ ≤ M ^ 6 := by
              apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
              rw [hMdef]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left het' (by positivity)
      _ = ((Finset.Ico 1 t).card : ℝ) * M ^ 6 := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ t * M ^ 6 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          rw [Nat.card_Ico]
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le t 1
  have hsplit : L * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ∑ ψ ∈ h.X c e, Chr.nrm (l : ℕ) c.O (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ) ≤
      L * (h.q * (B + M ^ C4)) + t * (h.N * (M ^ 2) ^ Cm) :=
    sum_split (fun e => h.X c e) Oset (fun ψ e => Chr.nrm (l : ℕ) c.O (Vlen (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ)) t h.N h.q L
      ((M ^ 2) ^ Cm) (B + M ^ C4) (fun ψ e => Vn_nonneg (AlgebraicClosure ℚ) c e ψ) hL0 (by positivity)
      (add_nonneg hB (pow_nonneg hM0 _)) (fun e => (xCard c.O h.N).1 _) hOcard
      (fun e he ψ hψ => (hkey e (Finset.mem_Ico.1 he).1 (Finset.mem_Ico.1 he).2 ψ hψ).2) hO2
  have hT0 : ((h.X c 0 ∪ h.X c 1).card : ℝ) ≤ h.N := by exact_mod_cast (xCard c.O h.N).1 _
  have hlossnn : 0 ≤ ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have s1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hL0
  rw [mul_add] at s1
  have s2 : L * (((h.X c 0 ∪ h.X c 1).card : ℝ) * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((lossAll (l : ℕ) h.N h.H.index e : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      L * (h.N * (t * M ^ 6)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hT0 hloss hlossnn (by positivity)) hL0

nodes.title: Bound the sum over arbitrary finite sets of other primes
nodes.contract: Choose a common exponent and two auxiliary primes before the host. The positive-part sum over every allowed finite set of nonexceptional odd primes is at most (Nt)^C.
nodes.idea: Apply Case I to the unrestricted contribution. For the remainder ℓ−1 divides twice the twist, bounding the number of relevant primes. Cases Z, II and III and the character counts control these terms.
nodes.lean_head:
theorem UpperTheory.V.HV.sumOut :
    CountI → CountZ → CountII → CountIII → SumOut
nodes.excerpt:
theorem UpperTheory.V.HV.sumOut :
    CountI → CountZ → CountII → CountIII → SumOut := by
  classical
  intro hI hZ hII hIII χ
  obtain ⟨C1, r₁, r₂, hr₁, hr₂, hI⟩ := hI χ
  obtain ⟨CZ, hZ⟩ := hZ χ
  obtain ⟨C2, hII⟩ := hII χ
  obtain ⟨C3, hIII⟩ := hIII χ
  refine ⟨C1 + 3 * max CZ (max C2 C3) + 4, r₁, r₂, hr₁, hr₂, ?_⟩
  intro h hχ hq1 hd hq1' hd' t ht2 hbig E _ _ _ hE Ω _ _ _ ld S hS
  subst hχ
  obtain ⟨Ω0, iF, iC, iA⟩ := exists_closure
  set K := max CZ (max C2 C3) with hK
  have hN1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (h.N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h.N_pos
  have ht2' : (2:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht2
  set M : ℝ := (h.N : ℝ) * t with hM
  have hM2 : 2 ≤ M := by nlinarith
  have htM : (t:ℝ) ≤ M := by nlinarith
  have hNM : (h.N:ℝ) ≤ M := by nlinarith
  haveI : NeZero h.N.totient := ⟨(Nat.totient_pos.2 h.N_pos).ne'⟩
  choose c hc using fun l : Nat.Primes => exists_coef (l : ℕ) h.N.totient
  have hfacts := fun (l : Nat.Primes) (hl : l ∈ S) =>
    (bchiFacts h t hbig).2.2.2.2 (l:ℕ) l.2 (hS l hl).1 (hS l hl).2
  have hother : ∀ l ∈ S, ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e →
      ∀ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, VLe Ω0 (c l) e ψ (M ^ (3 * K)) := by
    intro l hl e he1 he2 hn ψ hψ
    have hl2 := (hS l hl).1
    have hlB := (hS l hl).2
    have hchar := ((Host.mem_X h).1 hψ).1
    have hc4 := ((UpperTheory.V.HV.cases h t hbig (↥(c l).O) ψ hchar (l:ℕ) e l.2 hl2 he1 he2).1 hlB).2.2.2.2.2
    have hdv : (l:ℕ) - 1 ∣ 2 * e := by
      simp only [Host.CaseI, not_and, not_not] at hn
      exact hn hlB
    have hle := (hfacts l hl).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 e he1 he2 hdv
    have hl' : ((l:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 2 * t := by exact_mod_cast hle.2.1
    have he' : (e:ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast he2.le
    have hl1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast l.2.one_lt.le
    have he1' : (1:ℝ) ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast he1
    have hbase1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N * e := by
      have a1 := mul_le_mul hl1 hN1 zero_le_one (by positivity)
      have a2 := mul_le_mul a1 he1' zero_le_one (by positivity)
      simpa using a2
    have hbase : ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N * e ≤ M ^ 3 := by
      have a1 : ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N ≤ (2 * t) * h.N := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl' (by positivity)
      have a2 : ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N * e ≤ (2 * t) * h.N * t :=
        mul_le_mul a1 he' (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
      have a4 : 2 * M * t ≤ M * M * t :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM2 hM0) (by positivity)
      have a5 : M * M * t ≤ M * M * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htM (by positivity)
      have a3 : (2 * (t:ℝ)) * h.N * t = 2 * M * t := by rw [hM]; ring
      calc _ ≤ _ := a2
        _ = 2 * M * t := a3
        _ ≤ M * M * M := a4.trans a5
        _ = M ^ 3 := by ring
    have key : ∀ C', C' ≤ K → VLe Ω0 (c l) e ψ ((((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N * e) ^ C') →
        VLe Ω0 (c l) e ψ (M ^ (3 * K)) := by
      intro C' hC' v
      apply VLe.mono Ω0 (c l) v
      calc _ ≤ (((l:ℕ):ℝ) * h.N * e) ^ K := pow_le_pow_right₀ hbase1 hC'
        _ ≤ (M ^ 3) ^ K := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hbase K
        _ = M ^ (3 * K) := by rw [← pow_mul]
    rcases hc4 with h1 | h1 | h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 hn
    · exact key CZ (le_max_left _ _) (hZ h rfl t hbig Ω0 (l:ℕ) (c l) e hl2 he1 he2 ψ hψ h1)
    · exact key C2 (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
        (hII h rfl t hbig Ω0 (l:ℕ) (c l) e hl2 he1 he2 ψ hψ h1)
    · exact key C3 (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
        (hIII h rfl t hbig Ω0 (l:ℕ) (c l) e hl2 he1 he2 ψ hψ h1)
  have hfin : ∀ l ∈ S, ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → ∀ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vlen Ω0 (c l) e ψ ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro l hl e he1 he2 ψ hψ
    by_cases hn : h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e
    · have hLs : ∀ l' ∈ ({l} : Finset Nat.Primes), (l':ℕ) ≠ 2 ∧ h.CaseI (l':ℕ) e := by
        intro l' hl'
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hl'
        rw [hl']
        exact ⟨(hS _ hl).1, hn⟩
      exact (hI h rfl hq1 hd hq1' hd' t hbig e he1 he2 Ω0 c {l} hLs).1 l
        (Finset.mem_singleton_self l) ψ hψ
    · exact (hother l hl e he1 he2 hn ψ hψ).1
  have hper : ∀ l ∈ S, (∀ e, 0 < e → e < t → plusLen (ld l) e ≠ ⊤) ∧
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((plusLen (ld l) e).toNat : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ := by
    intro l hl
    haveI := (c l).dvr
    haveI := (c l).fin
    haveI := hc l
    have hidx := (hfacts l hl).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hlev := hostLevel h E hE
    have hT : ∀ e, (↑(h.X (c l) e) : Set (DirichletCharacter (↥(c l).O) h.N)) =
        Chr.evenSet (↥(c l).O) h.H e := by
      intro e
      ext ψ
      simp [Host.mem_X, Chr.evenSet, Host.IsChar, PsiEven]
    have hred := fun e (he : e ≠ 0) =>
      redPrime E h.N h.H hlev (l:ℕ) (hS l hl).1 hidx (c l) Ω (ld l) Ω0 e he (h.X (c l) e) (hT e)
    have r := Chr.sumBack (l:ℕ) (↥(c l).O) (DirichletCharacter (↥(c l).O) h.N)
      (fun e => if e < t then h.X (c l) e else ∅)
      ((Finset.range t).biUnion (fun e => h.X (c l) e))
      (fun ψ e => Vlen Ω0 (c l) e ψ) (fun e => plusLen (ld l) e) (fun _ => 0) t
      (by
        intro e
        split_ifs with h'
        · intro ψ hψ
          exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨e, Finset.mem_range.2 h', hψ⟩
        · exact Finset.empty_subset _)
      (by
        intro e he1 he2
        simp only [he2, if_true, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
        exact ⟨hfin l hl e he1 he2, hred e he1.ne'⟩)
    refine ⟨r.1, ?_⟩
    have r2 := r.2
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at r2
    refine r2.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_))
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at he
    simp only [if_pos he.2]
    rfl
  have hstep : ∀ e, 0 < e → e < t →
      ∑ l ∈ S, Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ ≤
        M ^ C1 + 2 * M * M ^ (3 * K) := by
    intro e he1 he2
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun l : Nat.Primes => h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e)]
    have hLs : ∀ l ∈ S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e), (l:ℕ) ≠ 2 ∧ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e := by
      intro l hl
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hl
      exact ⟨(hS l hl.1).1, hl.2⟩
    have hA := (hI h rfl hq1 hd hq1' hd' t hbig e he1 he2 Ω0 c _ hLs).2
    have hB : ∀ l ∈ S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e),
        Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ ≤ (h.N:ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K) := by
      intro l hl
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hl
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      calc ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ
          ≤ ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, M ^ (3 * K) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro ψ hψ
            rw [mul_comm]
            exact (hother l hl.1 e he1 he2 hl.2 ψ hψ).2
        _ = ((h.X (c l) e).card : ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (h.N:ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
            exact_mod_cast (xCard (↥(c l).O) h.N).1 _
    have hcard : ((S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e)).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * t := by
      have := card_small (S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e)) (2 * t) (by
        intro l hl
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hl
        have hn := hl.2
        simp only [Host.CaseI, not_and, not_not] at hn
        exact ((hfacts l hl.1).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 e he1 he2 (hn (hS l hl.1).2)).2.1)
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hB' : ∑ l ∈ S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e),
        Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ ≤ 2 * M * M ^ (3 * K) := by
      calc _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e), (h.N:ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum hB
        _ = ((S.filter (fun l : Nat.Primes => ¬ h.CaseI (l:ℕ) e)).card : ℝ) * ((h.N:ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ (2 * t) * ((h.N:ℝ) * M ^ (3 * K)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * M * M ^ (3 * K) := by rw [hM]; ring
    exact add_le_add hA hB'
  refine ⟨fun l hl e he1 he2 => (hper l hl).1 e he1 he2, ?_⟩
  calc ∑ l ∈ S, Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) * ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ((plusLen (ld l) e).toNat : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ l ∈ S, Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) *
          ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro l hl
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hper l hl).2
        exact Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast l.2.one_lt.le)
    _ = ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, ∑ l ∈ S, Real.log ((l:ℕ):ℝ) *
          ∑ ψ ∈ h.X (c l) e, Vn Ω0 (c l) e ψ := by
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t, (M ^ C1 + 2 * M * M ^ (3 * K)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro e he
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at he
        exact hstep e (by omega) he.2
    _ ≤ (t:ℝ) * (M ^ C1 + 2 * M * M ^ (3 * K)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, nsmul_eq_mul]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le t 1
    _ ≤ M ^ (C1 + 3 * K + 4) := final_le M t C1 (3 * K) hM2 htM

nodes.title: The first moment of the Chebyshev error
nodes.contract: The truncated integral of (ψ(t)−t)/t² from 1 to U tends to −1−γ as U tends to infinity.
nodes.idea: This is an improper-integral limit for the real von Mangoldt sum. It fixes the coefficient of the linear centering term in the reading converse.
nodes.lean_head: def PsiZeroConst : Prop

nodes.title: Evaluate the first moment
nodes.contract: The archive supplies its first-moment limit without an RH assumption.
nodes.idea: The public theorem calls the source-level proof psiZeroConst_main. This separate theorem helps explain the reverse implication for the singleton zeta family.

  exact Formalism.HermitianLattices.P.PsiZeroIntegral.psiZeroConst_main

nodes.title: Match the two limits at one
nodes.contract: For the trivial character modulo one the Chebyshev remainder has first moment −1−γ.
nodes.idea: Evaluate the Mellin integral for real σ>1 in terms of the logarithmic derivative of zeta. The remainder bound allows passage to σ=1. The finite part of the logarithmic derivative fixes the value.
nodes.lean_head: private theorem psiZeroConst_main : Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst
nodes.excerpt:
private theorem psiZeroConst_main : Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst := by
  unfold Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2a2.PsiZeroConst
  have hsub : Subsingleton (ZMod 1) := ZMod.subsingleton_iff.2 rfl
  have hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (n : ZMod 1) = 1 := fun n => by
    first
      | exact MulChar.one_apply (isUnit_of_subsingleton _)
      | simp
  have h : RemBound (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 := by
    have h0 := sw_bound 1 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h0
    simp only [hone, mul_one] at h0
    exact h0
  have hid : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ →
      (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = -(deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ + 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) - 1 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hre : (1 : ℝ) < ((σ : ℂ)).re := by simpa using hσ
    have hne : (σ : ℂ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [sub_ne_zero]
      exact_mod_cast hσ.ne'
    have hne' : -(σ : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      linear_combination -h0
    have hsum : LSeriesSummable (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ := by
      first
        | exact ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hre
        | exact LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hre
    have hL := LSeries_eq_mul_integral (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) zero_le_one hre hsum (rem_bigO h)
    have key : LSeries (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ = -deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ :=
      LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div hre
    have hpint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ))) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_cpow_of_lt (by simpa using hσ) one_pos
    have hsplit : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (∑ k ∈ Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, ((Λ k : ℝ) : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = (∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
          + ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) := by
      rw [← integral_add (core_integrable' h hσ.le) hpint]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun t ht => ?_)
      have ht0 : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℝ) < t from lt_trans one_pos ht).ne'
      simp only [rem]
      rw [show -(σ : ℂ) = 1 + (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)) by ring, Complex.cpow_add _ _ ht0, Complex.cpow_one]
      ring
    have hpow : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) = 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1) := by
      rw [integral_Ioi_cpow_of_lt (by simpa using hσ) one_pos, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.one_cpow,
        div_eq_div_iff hne' hne]
      ring
    have hq : (σ : ℂ) * (1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) = 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1) + 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_add_one hne]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hmain : (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
        rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))
        = LSeries (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) σ - (σ : ℂ) * (1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) := by
      rw [hL, hsplit, hpow]
      ring
    rw [hmain, key, hq]
    ring
  have hG : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => -(deriv riemannZeta σ / riemannZeta σ + 1 / ((σ : ℂ) - 1)) - 1)
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (-(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) - 1)) :=
    ((zeta_logderiv_limit.comp ofReal_tendsto_punctured).neg).sub_const 1
  have hF : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
      rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (-(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) - 1)) := by
    refine hG.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
    exact (hid σ hσ).symm
  have hlim := tendsto_nhds_unique (core_tendsto h) hF
  have hF1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
      rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 u * (u : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1))
        = (((Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [show -(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1) = -((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) by norm_num, Complex.cpow_neg, Complex.cpow_natCast]
    simp only [rem, Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => (Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2)
      (Set.Ioi 1) := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.Integrable.re (core_integrable h)).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    simp only [hF1 u hu, RCLike.re_to_complex, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have e1 : ∫ u in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (((Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = ∫ u in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ),
        rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ)) 1 u * (u : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1)) :=
    (setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hF1).symm
  have hval : ∫ u in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2
      = -1 - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant := by
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    have e0 : ∫ u in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (((Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ((∫ u in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), (Formalism.HermitianLattices.GL2PrimeSums.psumR (fun n => Λ n) u - u) / u ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      first
        | exact integral_complex_ofReal
        | exact integral_ofReal
    rw [← e0, e1, hlim]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hT := intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi 1 hint tendsto_id
  rw [hval] at hT
  exact hT

nodes.title: Dominate the centered character sum
nodes.contract: For each fixed character, the centered von Mangoldt sum is eventually bounded in norm by Kt/log²t.
nodes.idea: The Siegel–Walfisz estimate applies at a fixed modulus for all sufficiently large t. Exponential decay in the square root of log t implies the displayed inverse logarithmic factor.
assumptions: A fixed positive modulus and a Dirichlet character.
nodes.lean_head: private lemma sw_bound (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : RemBound (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)) (if χ = 1 then 1 else 0)
nodes.excerpt:
private lemma sw_bound (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    RemBound (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)) (if χ = 1 then 1 else 0) := by
  obtain ⟨c, C, hc, h⟩ := Formalism.ZeroFreeDirichlet.siegelWalfisz 1 one_pos
  have hE : 0 < Real.exp (q : ℝ) := Real.exp_pos _
  refine ⟨|C| * (24 / c ^ 4), Real.exp q + 2, by linarith, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have ht2 : 2 ≤ t := by linarith
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hq : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.log t ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le ht0]
    linarith
  have h1 := h q χ t ht2 hq
  have e : rem (fun n : ℕ => ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * χ (n : ZMod q)) (if χ = 1 then 1 else 0) t =
      Formalism.ZeroFreeDirichlet.psiChi χ t - (if χ = 1 then (t : ℂ) else 0) := by
    unfold rem Formalism.ZeroFreeDirichlet.psiChi
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [e]
  refine h1.trans ?_
  have h2 := exp_sqrt_le hc (x := t) (by linarith)
  calc C * t * Real.exp (-c * Real.sqrt (Real.log t))
      ≤ |C| * t * (24 / c ^ 4 / Real.log t ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
        exact le_abs_self C
    _ = |C| * (24 / c ^ 4) * t / Real.log t ^ 2 := by ring

nodes.title: Pass the Mellin integral to σ = 1
nodes.contract: A logarithmic remainder bound lets σ times the weighted integral tend to its value at σ=1 from the right.
nodes.idea: The local integrand is measurable. A bound by the integrable error at σ=1 gives dominated convergence. The factor σ tends to one.
assumptions: The explicit RemBound for the coefficients and their linear main term.
nodes.lean_head: private lemma core_tendsto {a : ℕ → ℂ} {m : ℂ} (h : RemBound a m) : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1))))
nodes.excerpt:
private lemma core_tendsto {a : ℕ → ℂ} {m : ℂ} (h : RemBound a m) :
    Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1)))) := by
  have hI : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => ∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1)))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (∫ t in Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ), rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1)))) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun t => ‖rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-(((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + 1))‖) ?_ ?_ (core_integrable h).norm ?_
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun σ => (F_measurable a m _).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
      exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => F_bound a m (le_of_lt hσ) ht
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
      have ht0 : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) < t := lt_trans zero_lt_one ht
        exact_mod_cast this.ne'
      have hc : Continuous (fun σ : ℝ => rem a m t * (t : ℂ) ^ (-((σ : ℂ) + 1))) :=
        continuous_const.mul (Continuous.const_cpow (by fun_prop) (Or.inl ht0))
      exact (hc.tendsto 1).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hσ : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 1).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  simpa using hσ.mul hI

nodes.title: Read Euler’s constant from the logarithmic derivative
nodes.contract: As complex s tends puncturedly to 1, ζ′(s)/ζ(s)+1/(s−1) tends to γ.
nodes.idea: Remove the pole by putting g(s)=(s−1)ζ(s) and g(1)=1. The quotient g′/g tends to γ and agrees with the regularized logarithmic derivative off the pole.
nodes.lean_head: private lemma zeta_logderiv_limit : Tendsto (fun s : ℂ => deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s + 1 / (s - 1)) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ))
nodes.excerpt:
private lemma zeta_logderiv_limit :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℂ => deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s + 1 / (s - 1)) (𝓝[≠] 1)
      (𝓝 (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ)) := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, g = Function.update (fun s => (s - 1) * riemannZeta s) 1 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgs : ∀ s : ℂ, s ≠ 1 → g s = (s - 1) * riemannZeta s := fun s hs => by
    simp [hg, Function.update_apply, hs]
  have h1 : g 1 = 1 := by simp [hg]
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ g := by
    have hon : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Set.univ \ {1}) := by
      intro s hs
      have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := hs.2
      have hev : g =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun z => (z - 1) * riemannZeta z := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hs1] with z hz
        exact hgs z hz
      exact (((differentiableAt_id.sub_const 1).mul (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hs1)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        hev).differentiableWithinAt
    have hcont : ContinuousAt g 1 := by
      rw [continuousAt_iff_punctured_nhds, h1]
      refine riemannZeta_residue_one.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      exact (hgs s hs).symm
    have hall := (Complex.differentiableOn_compl_singleton_and_continuousAt_iff Filter.univ_mem).1 ⟨hon, hcont⟩
    exact differentiableOn_univ.1 hall
  have hd1 : deriv g 1 = Real.eulerMascheroniConstant := by
    have h2 := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.1 (hdiff 1).hasDerivAt
    have h3 : Tendsto (slope g 1) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ)) := by
      refine tendsto_riemannZeta_sub_one_div.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      have hs1 : s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs
      rw [slope_def_field, hgs s hs, h1]
      first
        | (field_simp; done)
        | (field_simp; ring)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h3
  have hcd : ContinuousAt (deriv g) 1 := ((hdiff.analyticAt 1).deriv).continuousAt
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun s => deriv g s / g s) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ)) := by
    have h4 : Tendsto (fun s => deriv g s / g s) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 (deriv g 1 / g 1)) :=
      (hcd.div (hdiff 1).continuousAt (by rw [h1]; exact one_ne_zero)).tendsto.mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    rw [hd1, h1, div_one] at h4
    exact h4
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  have hne : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ), g s ≠ 0 :=
    ((hdiff 1).continuousAt.eventually_ne (by rw [h1]; exact one_ne_zero)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hne] with s hs hgs0
  have hs1 : s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs
  have hev : g =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun z => (z - 1) * riemannZeta z := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hs] with z hz
    exact hgs z hz
  have hdg : deriv g s = riemannZeta s + (s - 1) * deriv riemannZeta s := by
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have h5 : HasDerivAt (fun z => (z - 1) * riemannZeta z)
        (1 * riemannZeta s + (s - 1) * deriv riemannZeta s) s :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' s).sub_const 1).mul (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hs).hasDerivAt
    rw [h5.deriv]
    ring
  rw [hgs s hs] at hgs0 ⊢
  have hz : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hgs0
  rw [hdg]
  first
    | (field_simp; done)
    | (field_simp; ring)

import Mathlib

def RiemannZetaZerosOnLine : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℂ, riemannZeta s = 0 → (¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1)) → s ≠ 1 → s.re = 1 / 2

def DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (s : ℂ),
    1 / 2 < s.re → (χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0

def DirichletLZerosOnLine : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (s : ℂ),
    0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2

def PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N), χ.IsPrimitive →
    ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2

/-- The headline claim, stated with Mathlib's definition only. -/
